jobs.title: Principle Security Engineer
jobs.description: At Cetera, our Information Security organization protects employees, advisors, and clients from evolving cyber threats across cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI\-enabled technologies. As artificial intelligence capabilities expand across the enterprise, Cetera is building a formal AI risk and compliance program — grounded in industry\-recognized AI risk management frameworks — to ensure innovation aligns with regulatory, security, and third\-party risk expectations. We are seeking an AI Risk and Compliance Engineer to operationalize AI governance controls, manage AI\-related third\-party and vendor risk, and lead adversarial threat modeling for AI/ML systems using the MITRE ATLAS framework. This role serves as a key bridge across IT Risk, Cloud Security, Legal/Procurement, and AI/ML Engineering teams, translating AI risk management framework requirements into practical, auditable processes within a regulated financial services environment. **What will you do:** * **Operationalize AI governance controls:** Implement and maintain controls aligned to recognized AI risk management frameworks (spanning governance, mapping, measurement, and management of AI risk), including control documentation, risk\-control matrices (RCM), and evidence collection to support audits and regulatory exams. * **Lead AI third\-party risk management:** Evaluate and onboard third\-party AI/ML tools and vendors against security, privacy, and compliance criteria; document AI\-specific vendor and contract requirements, SLAs, and fourth\-party disclosures; support due diligence for AI vendors and data provenance reviews. * **Maintain AI/vendor risk inventories** : Build and maintain documentation of third\-party AI components (models, datasets, APIs, pre\-trained/foundation models) covering provenance, functionality, and known limitations, and map internal controls to those components. * **Run ongoing AI risk assessments:** Conduct recurring vendor risk and compliance assessments covering AI system performance, data quality, algorithmic bias, and security controls; monitor pre\-trained/foundation model drift and SLA adherence; assess concentration and dependency risk across AI vendors. * **Perform AI threat modeling** : Design and execute threat models for AI/ML systems using the MITRE ATLAS framework to identify adversarial tactics and techniques — including prompt injection, data/model poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, and supply\-chain risk in ML pipelines — across the AI development and deployment lifecycle. * **Coordinate adversarial testing:** Plan and coordinate red\-teaming, adversarial testing, and penetration testing of AI/ML systems, and drive ongoing threat assessments informed by current threat intelligence and prior incidents. * **Integrate AI into vulnerability management** : Ensure AI\-specific vulnerabilities and security findings are captured, prioritized, and remediated through existing enterprise vulnerability management processes. * **Identify and assess unsanctioned AI usage** : Support discovery and risk assessment of unsanctioned (shadow) AI tool usage across the enterprise and recommend remediation or approval pathways. * **Partner cross\-functionally:** Work closely with IT Risk, Cloud Security, Legal, Procurement, and Application/AI Engineering teams to embed AI risk and compliance requirements into intake, procurement, and development processes. * **Support governance and audit activities:** Develop and maintain AI risk standards, control narratives, and runbooks; support internal and external audits and regulatory compliance activities (e.g., FINRA) by producing control evidence tied to the organization's AI risk management framework. **What you will have:** * 10\+ years of experience in IT/cyber risk, GRC, security engineering, or a related discipline, with direct exposure to AI/ML systems * Working knowledge of AI risk and control frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF or similar industry AI risk management frameworks) and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs * Practical experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threat modeling methodologies for AI/ML systems, including familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK and MITRE ATLAS * Experience building or operating third\-party/vendor risk management processes — due diligence, contracting/SLAs, ongoing monitoring, and issue remediation * Understanding of AI\-specific attack techniques (prompt injection, data/model poisoning, model evasion, model extraction/inversion) and associated mitigations * Ability to translate technical risk findings into control objectives, policy language, and audit\-ready documentation * Experience in regulated environments (financial services or FINRA preferred) * Strong communication skills across technical, risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with GRC platforms (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC) for control and risk\-register management * Certifications such as CRISC, CISSP, CCSP, or IAPP AIGP (AI Governance Profe me roles, a benefits package including: * Inclusive health, dental, vision, and life insurance plans built to support diverse lifestyles, offer preventative care, and protect against hardship. * Easy access to mental health benefits to meet our team members and their families where they are. * 20\+ days of paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, and 2 paid wellness days to give our employees the time they need to stay close with their loved ones, recharge, and give back to their communities. * 401(k) savings plan with a generous company contribution (up to 5%), and access to a financial professional to offer our employees the opportunity to plan\-ahead for a strong financial future well beyond their working years. * Paid parental leave to support all team members with birth, adoption, and fostering. * Health Savings and Flexible Spending Account options to help you save money on healthcare, daycare, commuting, and more. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP), LifeLock, Pet Insurance and more. * Paid caregiver leave to provide time away from work when caring for an ill or recovering family member. * Additional benefits such as an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), identity theft protection (LifeLock), pet insurance, and other voluntary benefits to provide extra peace of mind **About Cetera** Cetera Financial Group ® (Cetera) is a leading network of independent retail broker\-dealers and registered investment advisers empowering the delivery of objective financial advice to individuals, families, and company retirement plans across the country through trusted financial advisors and financial institutions. Cetera is one of the largest independent financial advisor networks in the nation and a leading provider of retail services to the investment programs of banks and credit unions. Advisor support resources offered through Cetera include award\-winning wealth management and advisory platforms, comprehensive broker\-dealer and registered investment adviser services, practice management support, and innovative technology. Cetera Financial Group (Cetera) is a network of independent retail firms, including those that are members of FINRA/SIPC: Cetera Advisors LLC; Cetera Wealth Services, LLC (formerly known as Cetera Advisor Networks); Cetera Investment Services LLC (marketed as Cetera Financial Institutions or Cetera Investors); and Cetera Financial Specialists LLC. Entities registered as investment advisers with the Securities and Exchange Commission include Cetera Investment Management LLC and Cetera Investment Advisers LLC. jobs.title: Junior Marketing Designer
jobs.description: **ChopAir \| Kansas City, MO \| West Bottoms** **Full\-Time \| In Office** **Salary: $45,000–$50,000 annually** ChopAir is looking for a **Junior Marketing Designer** to join our growing marketing team. This is a design\-first role for someone early in their career who wants to develop across presentations, print, web, UX, content, brand work, and podcast production. You’ll work directly with **Wyatt Miller, ChopAir’s Marketing Manager**, and collaborate with teams throughout the company. We’re not just looking for someone who can make things look nice. We want someone curious about **why** something works. Why this layout? Why this color? Why this hierarchy? We want someone who enjoys exploring those questions and wants to keep getting better at answering them. **What You’ll Work On** Presentations \& Collateral * PowerPoint presentations and sales decks * Proposals and one\-pagers * Brochures and product collateral * Trade show graphics, signage, and displays * Internal and external branded materials Web \& Content * WordPress website updates * Product and manufacturer pages * Blog layouts and supporting graphics * Website imagery * General UX and content improvements * Exposure to SEO and digital marketing strategy Podcast \& Media Production * Assist with filming and recording ChopAir’s company podcast * Set up cameras, lighting, microphones, and basic recording equipment * Edit podcast footage for full\-length episodes and short\-form LinkedIn content * Perform basic video and audio synchronization, color correction, and editing * Design episode graphics, thumbnails, and promotional materials * Create branded visual assets for LinkedIn promotion * Organize and prepare video, audio, and graphic files for distribution * Understand appropriate file formats, resolutions, and export settings for different publishing needs * Support podcast publishing and distribution across designated platforms Creative Support * Image editing and photo manipulation * Brand and campaign graphics * Social media and email marketing creative * Photography and video support * Sales and marketing materials * Other creative projects as the company continues to grow * Photography experience is a plus, but not a requirement. **How We Work** Good design at ChopAir is intentional, not decorative. We want you thinking through your choices, not simply defending them. You won’t always be right, and neither will we. What matters is being able to explain your thinking, take feedback, learn from it, and continue improving the work. Communication matters a lot in this role. If something is unclear, ask. If priorities shift, communicate it. We would rather solve a problem early than discover it at the end of a project. We’re also a collaborative team, not a competitive one. We share ideas, teach each other, and jump in when someone needs help. Titles don’t excuse anyone from that. We believe creativity works best when people enjoy what they do. We take our work seriously, but that doesn't mean every day needs to feel serious. There's room to experiment, laugh, share ideas, and occasionally step away from a project when you need a fresh perspective. We want to create an environment where people enjoy coming to work and feel proud of what they create. **You’re Allowed to Be Junior** We don’t expect you to walk in knowing our industry, every tool, or our internal processes. You’ll receive direction and support while you learn, with more responsibility and ownership as your confidence grows. You’ll have opportunities to explore different areas of marketing and design, discover your strengths, and develop new ones. The goal over time is to move from: **“Tell me what to make.”** To: **“Here’s how I think we should solve this.”** We’re looking for someone who wants to grow into that kind of designer. **What We’d Like to See** * Strong foundation in typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and color * Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign * Strong comfort working in PowerPoint * Interest in video production, filming, and editing * Ability to take feedback and translate it into stronger creative work * Strong attention to detail * Clear communication and willingness to ask questions * Curiosity and a desire to continuously improve * Ability to organize projects and manage priorities across different creative tasks **Nice to Have** * WordPress experience * Figma or Adobe XD experience * Photography experience * Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar video editing software * Experience operating cameras, lighting, and audio recording equipment * Basic video and audio editing experience * Familiarity with video export settings, file formats, and publishing workflows * Podcast or media production experience * SEO familiarity * Digital marketing experience * Basic understanding of UX/UI principles A design\-related degree is welcome but **not required**. Your **portfolio, fundamentals, creativity, and thought process matter more than the name of your degree**. Recent graduates and early\-career designers are encouraged to apply. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Salary: $45,000–$50,000 annually**, depending on experience * Health benefits * Paid time off * Opportunity to grow alongside an expanding company and marketing department * Direct mentorship and professional development from ChopAir’s Marketing Manager * Exposure to multiple areas of design, marketing, and media production * Opportunities to take ownership of projects as your skills develop **Location** This is an **in\-office position** based at ChopAir’s office in the **West Bottoms of Kansas City, Missouri**. The role involves collaborating directly with our marketing and sales teams, participating in creative discussions, and supporting hands\-on projects, including photography, podcast filming, and physical collateral production. **About ChopAir** ChopAir is a growing commercial and industrial HVAC manufacturer’s representative and distributor serving contractors, engineers, building owners, and developers. Our business spans air distribution, ventilation, industrial fans, building controls, heating, and other specialty HVAC solutions. As ChopAir continues to grow, so does the way we communicate our brand, products, expertise, and relationships. Our marketing department supports everything from technical presentations and digital experiences to campaigns, trade shows, and media production. We're building a company that values technical expertise, strong relationships, thoughtful execution, creativity, and people who want to keep getting better at what they do. **Ready to Apply?** Send us your resume and portfolio showcasing your design work. We’re interested in seeing how you think, not just the finished product. Whether your portfolio includes school projects, freelance work, personal projects, or professional experience, we want to see what you can do and what excites you about design. **Portfolio required with application.** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. Directs and supervises the activities of skilled and unskilled subordinates in the varied work associated with the installation, maintenance, and repair of water distribution facilities, while performing the same duties oneself. Employees in this class work with considerable independence and are expected to exercise skill and judgement in carrying out instructions given by superiors. Prepares and submits reports, works on a scheduled 40 hr week, and responds to emergency calls on a 24\-hour a week basis when requested by a superior. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Includes the following: Insuring that work is performed in a safe, efficient manner, according to all safety regulations and policies Receiving job orders from supervisors indicating problems and their location, drawing tools and materials necessary to accomplish this task Directing and coordinating the work of skilled and unskilled subordinates engaged in the installation and repair of water services, water mains, hydrants, valves and other water system appurtenances and equipment. Make sound decisions and judgements to effectively and safely install, repair or replace water utility infrastructure and guide subordinate personnel in same. Instructing subordinates in the performance of more complex types of installations and repairs Ability to read and interpret water system maps and sketches of the water distribution system as prepared and maintained by the PWSB Engineering Department. Work directly with PWSB Engineers and GIS / CAD Administrator personnel to update and provide information for updating of water system mapping. Supervising and participating in the repair of water main leaks and breaks, service leaks, valve leaks and damaged hydrants on a 24 hour, 7 days a week basis when requested by a supervisor Supervising and participating in the flushing of system mains by operating hydrants and monitoring water quality Supervising and making service taps and installing new service lines Supervising and operating water main tapping equipment and installing tapping sleeves Supervising and participating in the operation of valves Supervising and assisting in the installation of concrete meter pits, piping, valves and meters located in pits Performing work in the installation of new piping, pumps, air release valves, pressure reducing valves, and other distribution system equipment Operating heavy equipment and crew service vehicles Performing leak detection analysis on all components of the water system by methods of survey, listening devices, monitoring meter equipment and measuring devices to quantify flow Performing system pressure and hydrant flow tests Preparing reports and sketches of various types of water installations and service records which are submitted to a supervisor Supervising proper methods of chlorinating water mains to keep them free from contamination during construction or repair Using a personal computer or other keyboard device and tablets to prepare reports, enter information and update data bases. Possess a basic knowledge and use of GIS related software applications including portable tablets and devices with digital water distribution system mapping and asset related management software. Performing related work as required **QUALIFICATIONS** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** High school diploma or general education degree (GED) plus two or more years’ experience in water distribution. Previous supervisory experience helpful. A considerable knowledge of mechanical parts, the basic understanding of the operation of a potable water distribution system and hydraulic principles and practices, and other water systems appurtenances and the methods, tools, and materials used in their repair. Must be familiar with street ordinances that apply to construction, and have a working knowledge of OSHA excavation safety procedures. Must be able to read and interpret maps and drawings to locate water mains, gates, services and valves from both paper and digital maps and drawings. Planning ability necessary, as well as familiarity with municipal water systems Applicants will be administered a written test and/or evaluated by an outside authority to determine qualifications in water distribution maintenance and safety procedures and the ability to supervise a crew. **LANGUAGE SKILLS** Ability to read and interpret documents such as water system maps and sketches, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. **MATHEMATICAL SKILLS** Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs. **REASONING ABILITY** Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. **CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS** Must possess or ability to obtain a RI Water Distribution Operators License Grade 3D within a year of hire Valid Commercial Drivers’ License (CDL) Valid Drivers’ License Possess or obtain within one year of hire an OHSA Competent Person Certification **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts and outside weather conditions. The employee is frequently exposed to risk of electrical shock and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles and toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. PAY CLASSIFICATION With State of RI Water Distribution Operators License Grade II – R 46 \- $30\.61 With State of RI Water Distribution Operators License Grade III – R 48 \- $31\.68 With State of RI Water Distribution Operators License Grade IV – R 50 \- $34\.18 **Affiliations**: Council 94, AFSCME, AFL\-CIO Local 1012 Pay: $30\.61 \- $34\.18 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Associate
jobs.description: CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm wur purpose is to create opportunities every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry\-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you. CLA is seeking a **Cloud Engineer** to join our Digital team and support the delivery of client\-facing cloud infrastructure solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced cloud and infrastructure professionals while helping clients implement, migrate, secure, and optimize cloud environments. You will contribute to Microsoft 365, Azure, virtualization, and infrastructure modernization projects while expanding your technical expertise in a collaborative consulting environment. **How You’ll Create Opportunities in This Role** * Assist with the implementation, support, and maintenance of client cloud infrastructure solutions using modern cloud engineering and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. * Configure and support Microsoft 365, Azure, identity, networking, storage, backup, virtualization, and related cloud technologies. * Participate in cloud, tenant, workload, and infrastructure migrations, including planning, testing, cutover support, validation, and transition activities. * Gather and document business and technical requirements, current\-state environments, dependencies, and project considerations under the guidance of senior engineers. * Assess cloud and virtual infrastructure environments and provide recommendations for modernization, optimization, performance improvements, security enhancements, and operational efficiency. * Monitor cloud and virtual infrastructure environments and assist with troubleshooting availability, performance, authentication, configuration, backup, synchronization, and security\-related issues. * Contribute to automation and process improvement initiatives using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripting, source control, and DevOps tools. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including environment inventories, migration plans, procedures, runbooks, test results, and transition materials. * Apply cloud security, identity management, governance, compliance, monitoring, and change management practices. jobs.title: Sr. Network Automation Engineer (Python / Django API Development)
jobs.description: **Job Title: Sr. Network Automation Engineer (Python / Django API Development)** **Location: 100% Remote** **Duration: 6\+ Months Contract** **\*\*\*Ropes Online Assessment will be there\*\*\*** **Role Summary:** We are building self\-service endpoints that wrap the Cisco Network\-as\-Code (NaC) process, which runs as Terraform\-based GitLab pipelines, to give customers a consistent intake experience in place of manual handoffs. Requests are validated against various sources of truth, including Nautobot and IPAM. We are seeking a senior engineer to assist in the design and delivery of these Django services using integration\-test\-first TDD and sound software engineering principles. **Role Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain Django REST APIs that wrap the Cisco Network\-as\-Code (NaC) process as a customer intake service, covering request submission, validation, approval, and pipeline\-driven fulfillment. * Practice integration\-test\-first TDD: start each feature with failing API\-level integration tests (Django/DRF test client against a real test database), then drive the internals with focused unit tests, keeping business logic thoroughly covered. * Help define API contracts (schemas, versioning, error models, idempotency) and publish clear OpenAPI documentation. * Model intake data and workflows in Django (models, serializers, validators, service layer) with clean separation of concerns. * Integrate with GitLab to turn validated intake requests into NaC changes: generate YAML data model updates, open merge requests, trigger and monitor pipelines via the GitLab API and webhooks, and report status back to requesters. * Integrate with ServiceNow and other enterprise systems, using mocks and contract tests to isolate external dependencies. * Integrate with various sources of truth, including Nautobot and IPAM: validate intake requests against authoritative data (IPs, prefixes, VLANs, devices) and write results back via their APIs (e.g., Nautobot REST and GraphQL), avoiding duplicate data and drift. * Build and optimize Python scripts and Ansible playbooks supporting server onboarding and data center provisioning workflows. * Collaborate with Software Engineers and UX teams to align backend APIs with the self\-service portal. * Contribute to the service's CI/CD pipeline in GitLab: automated test gates, linting, static analysis, coverage thresholds, and repeatable, low\-risk deployments. * Implement robust error handling, input validation, logging, and authentication/authorization. * Apply Agile and DevOps practices: sprints, backlog grooming, code reviews, and pair programming. * Contribute to architecture decisions and engineering standards, mentor engineers, and share knowledge through documentation and demos. **Skills Required:** * Advanced Python with production Django and Django REST Framework experience (serializers, viewsets, permissions, ORM) * Test\-driven development with an integration\-tests\-first approach, plus unit testing (pytest or Django TestCase, APIClient, fixtures/factories, mocking, code coverage) * REST API design: resource modeling, versioning, pagination, idempotency, error handling, and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation * REST integrations with GitLab, ServiceNow, and enterprise platforms * Nautobot integration (REST and GraphQL APIs, e.g., pynautobot) and IPAM concepts (prefixes, IPs, VLANs, VRFs) * Relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) * Git/GitLab, merge request workflows, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines * Ansible and YAML for provisioning and onboarding automation * Networking fundamentals (VLANs, port configs, provisioning) and familiarity with Cisco network environments * Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices, including YAML data\-model\-driven configuration * Engineering Principles \& Methodology * Software engineering principles: SOLID, DRY, separation of concerns, clean architecture, refactoring, and technical debt management * Integration\-first testing strategy (integration tests at the API boundary, supported by unit and contract tests) enforced through CI, with GitLab, Nautobot, and ServiceNow interactions stubbed or mocked at the client boundary * Agile development (sprints, backlog management, standups, retrospectives) * DevOps practices (CI/CD, automation frameworks) * Clear technical documentation, including API and architecture documentation **Soft Skills:** * Strong collaboration in cross\-functional Agile teams * Effective communication with engineers and stakeholders * Problem\-solving and troubleshooting mindset * Adaptability to changing priorities * Ability to contribute to technical decisions and mentor through pair programming and code reviews **Preferred/Optional Skills:** * Understanding of Terraform principles and Cisco Network\-as\-Code (declarative configuration, state management, idempotency, modules, plan/apply workflows) * Nautobot app/plugin or Jobs development (Nautobot is built on Django) * Asynchronous task processing (e.g., Celery) and message queues * Docker/Kubernetes experience * Monitoring/observability tools Pay: $80\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Analytics Data Engineer II - Homes.com - Arlington, VA
jobs.description: Analytics Data Engineer II \- Homes.com \- Arlington, VA Job Description CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S\&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate. **Homes.com** **Overview** Homes.com is already one of the fastest growing real estate portals in the industry, we are driven to be \#1\. Just ask Brad Bellflower, Chief Change Officer at Apartments.com. After its acquisition in 2014, Apartments.com quickly turned into the most popular place to find a place. Proven success at the highest level – and we’re doing it again with the new Homes.com. Homes.com is a CoStar Group company with 20\+ years' experience in leading and growing digital marketplaces. We pride ourselves on continually improving, innovating, and setting the standard for property search and marketing experiences. With Homes.com we’re building a brand on the cusp of defining the industry. We’re looking for big thinkers, brave leaders, and creative advertising wizards ready to influence a new age of homebuying within a tried\-and\-true, award\-winning company. Learn more about Homes.com . **Position Overview** We are seeking a **n Analytics Data Engineer II** to join our Homes.com team to design and scale end\-to\-end data infrastructure, transforming raw data into high\-quality datasets that power both internal insights and customer\-facing product experiences. This role partners cross\-functionally to define data strategy, build reliable pipelines, and deliver scalable BI solutions that enable self\-service analytics and data\-driven decision\-making. The position also supports advanced data initiatives, including productionizing machine learning models and enhancing user experience through data\-driven insights. CoStar is investing heavily in artificial intelligence to accelerate software delivery, improve platform observability, automate research and business workflows, enhance product experiences through intelligent agents and skills, and improve data quality across enterprise systems. Successful candidates will demonstrate a willingness to learn, adopt, and apply AI technologies responsibly to solve complex business and engineering challenges. This position is located in Arlington, VA and is in office Monday through Thursday and work from home on Friday. **Responsibilities** * Own end\-to\-end design and deployment of automated data infrastructure – from defining initial data requirements and owning table/schema design to creating reliable, production data pipelines that power both internal analytics and customer\-facing product experiences. * Work with product and software engineering teams to define tracking strategy and data requirements; design and build automated scripts using SQL or python to transform raw source data into datasets for use in front\-end business products and for analysts across the company. * Develop and implement data quality and pipeline monitoring procedures to ensure accuracy and completeness of data, including validation rules, data audits, and resolution of data discrepancies. * Design warehouse architecture and infrastructure to support all business reporting needs. Design tables, schemas, and processes that efficiently compile datasets that support both analytical and front\-end use cases. * Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams on projects to understand their data needs and provide them with the tools and resources they need to access and analyze data. * Lead business analysis in support of strategic business development – work with stakeholders to help them access, analyze, and interpret data and understand business implications. * Develop and maintain scalable BI solutions in Power BI, built on curated datasets and data models to enable self\-service analytics and drive decision\-making across product, marketing, and sales teams * Apply analytical and data science techniques to curate datasets and develop models that power the Homes.com front\-end experience. * Partner with Data Science and Machine Learning teams to productionize models and scale advanced use cases, including applications of LLMs to synthesize user behavior and summarize engagement patterns. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited, not for profit, in\-person university or college. * A track record of commitment to prior employers * 3\+ years of experience with SQL, Python, PySpark, data warehousing, and business intelligence tools * 2\+ years of experience with data engineering tools, pipeline creation and management * Experience with cloud computing platforms and data warehouse solutions such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and Microsoft SQL Server * Experience working with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or PowerBI. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Understanding of AI technologies and hands\-on experience leveraging AI tooling in development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, Grok) * Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Google Analytics * Experience working with large consumer datasets to drive insights and create models * Experience working with product and tech teams * Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or agent\-based architectures * Great analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges * Ability to understand technical challenges and complex designs, and communicate into simple business ideas, or solutions with senior management/stakeholders * Background in the residential or commercial real estate industry **What’s In It For You?** When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed. We offer you generous compensation and performance\-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement. Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to): * Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug * Life, legal, and supplementary insurance * Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family * Commuter and parking benefits * 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions * Employee stock purchase plan * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * On\-site fitness center and/or reimbursed fitness center membership costs (location dependent), with yoga studio, Pelotons, personal training, group exercise classes * Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups * Complimentary gourmet coffee, tea, hot chocolate, fresh fruit, and other healthy snacks The final salary or hourly rate offered for this role will fall within the range set forth below based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. Base Compensation: $102,000\- 154,000 Annually We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full\-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. \#LI\-AV1 \#Homes.com CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment substance abuse testing

jobs.title: Consulting Principal - AI Architecture and Engineering Lead
jobs.description: ### **About Cognizant Consulting** Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant's consulting practice \- we're a global community of 5,000\+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we're looking for our next colleague who'll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you? ### **About the role** As an Associate Director, AI Architecture and Engineering Lead, you will make an impact by translating business priorities into secure, scalable, production\-grade AI platforms and customer\-facing solutions. You will be a valued member of the consulting team and work collaboratively with product, data, cloud, security, risk, legal, business leaders, engineering teams, and clients. ### **In this role, you will:** * Define and govern target architectures, reference patterns, reusable services, and engineering standards for enterprise AI, generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic applications, and AI\-enabled digital products. * Lead solutions from discovery and architecture through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and production operations, while remaining hands\-on in design reviews, prototyping, troubleshooting, and critical technical decisions. * Architect model\-agnostic AI solutions using frontier and open models, stateful agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool calling, memory, human approvals, Model Context Protocol, vector or graph retrieval, and secure enterprise integrations. * Establish AI platform and LLMOps practices covering prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, CI/CD, observability, rollback, incident response, latency, reliability, cost optimization, and responsible\-AI controls. * Lead, mentor, and develop architects and engineers while partnering with cross\-functional leaders to prioritize use cases, assess vendors, strengthen engineering quality, and deliver measurable outcomes. ### **Work model** We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Atlanta, Georgia. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations. ### **What you must have to be considered** * 12\+ years of software, platform, data, or cloud engineering experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or technical leadership, with demonstrated delivery of enterprise\-scale production AI systems. * Hands\-on expertise in LLM application engineering, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation, guardrails, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and multiple model providers. * Experience establishing secure, reliable AI platform and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD, observability, automated evaluation, incident response, privacy, security, governance, resilience, and cost optimization. * Experience guiding modern full\-stack and distributed\-system engineering using Angular and TypeScript, C\# and .NET, APIs and events, PostgreSQL or AlloyDB, Redis, vector or graph stores, containers, and Google Cloud services. * Strong executive communication, client\-facing leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, mentoring, and technical decision\-making skills. ### **These will help you succeed** * Experience with LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, GraphRAG, or comparable frameworks. * Experience applying AI\-native and specification\-driven engineering practices, including coding agents, automated testing, security checks, validation gates, architecture decisions, and requirement\-to\-code traceability. * Ability to assess emerging AI technologies and vendors, manage technical and business tradeoffs, and connect architecture decisions to measurable outcomes. * Ability to build engineering standards, lead design and code reviews, and develop communities of practice. * Experience operating in complex consulting or enterprise environments with accountability for delivery quality, reliability, security, and cost. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. ### **Compensation** $122,400 \- $223,500 This position is eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans. ### **Benefits** * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance * 401(k) plan and contributions * Employee stock purchase plan * Employee assistance program * 10 paid holidays plus PTO * Paid parental leave and fertility assistance * Learning and development certifications and programs

jobs.title: Senior Consulting Manager - AI Architecture & Engineering
jobs.description: ### **About Cognizant Consulting** Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant's consulting practice \- we're a global community of 5,000\+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we're looking for our next colleague who'll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you? ### **About the role** As a Senior Manager Consulting, AI Architecture and Engineering, you will make an impact by translating business priorities into secure, scalable, production\-grade AI platforms and customer\-facing solutions. You will be a valued member of the consulting team and work collaboratively with product, data, cloud, security, risk, legal, business leaders, engineering teams, and clients. ### **In this role, you will:** * Define and govern target architectures, reference patterns, reusable services, and engineering standards for enterprise AI, generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic applications, and AI\-enabled digital products. * Lead solutions from discovery and architecture through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and production operations, while remaining hands\-on in design reviews, prototyping, troubleshooting, and critical technical decisions. * Architect model\-agnostic AI solutions using frontier and open models, stateful agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool calling, memory, human approvals, Model Context Protocol, vector or graph retrieval, and secure enterprise integrations. * Establish AI platform and LLMOps practices covering prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, CI/CD, observability, rollback, incident response, latency, reliability, cost optimization, and responsible\-AI controls. * Lead, mentor, and develop architects and engineers while partnering with cross\-functional leaders to prioritize use cases, manage tradeoffs, assess vendors, strengthen engineering quality, and deliver measurable customer, employee, and operational outcomes. ### **Work model** We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in New Jersey, NJ. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations. ### **What you must have to be considered** * 12\+ years of software, platform, data, or cloud engineering experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or technical leadership, with demonstrated delivery of enterprise\-scale production AI systems. * Hands\-on expertise in LLM application engineering, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation, guardrails, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and multiple model providers. * Experience establishing secure, reliable AI platform and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD, observability, automated evaluation, incident response, privacy, security, governance, resilience, and cost optimization. * Experience guiding modern full\-stack and distributed\-system engineering using Angular and TypeScript, C\# and .NET, APIs and events, PostgreSQL or AlloyDB, Redis, vector or graph stores, containers, and Google Cloud services such as Vertex AI, Gemini, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. * Strong executive communication, client\-facing leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, mentoring, and technical decision\-making skills. ### **These will help you succeed** * Experience with LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, GraphRAG, or comparable frameworks. * Experience applying AI\-native and specification\-driven engineering practices, including coding agents, repository instructions, reusable skills, automated testing, security checks, validation gates, architecture decisions, and requirement\-to\-code traceability. * Ability to assess emerging AI technologies and vendors, manage technical and business tradeoffs, and connect architecture decisions to measurable outcomes. * Ability to build engineering standards, lead design and code reviews, and develop communities of practice. * Experience operating in complex consulting or enterprise environments with accountability for delivery quality, operational reliability, security, and cost. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. ### **Compensation** $98,853 \- $182,500 This position is eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans. ### **Benefits** * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance * 401(k) plan and contributions * Employee stock purchase plan * Employee assistance program * 10 paid holidays plus PTO * Paid parental leave and fertility assistance * Learning and development certifications and programs

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET & Angular)
jobs.description: About the role As a **Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET \& Angular)**, you will make an impact by designing, developing, and supporting modern applications within the Distribution domain, with a focus on a new quoting platform. You will be a valued member of a collaborative team consisting of Cognizant associates and contractors, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable, high\-quality solutions. This role requires strong full stack development expertise across Angular and .NET technologies, along with the ability to support application modernization initiatives. In this role, you will: * Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using Angular and .NET/C\# technologies. * Contribute to the development and enhancement of a new quoting application within the Distribution portfolio. * Collaborate with cross\-functional team members to deliver high\-quality software solutions and support ongoing product enhancements. * Develop and integrate REST APIs and cloud\-based services to enable scalable and reliable application functionality. * Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and Agile development activities while supporting team success across EST and PST operating hours. Work model: At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Indianapolis, Indiana. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. These may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as evolving business and client requirements. We will always be transparent about role expectations. Please note: Some roles may require in‑person interviews at Cognizant offices or client locations based on project needs. What you need to have to be considered * Experience as a Full Stack Engineer with strong expertise in **Angular (latest versions)** and **.NET/C\#** development. * Hands\-on experience building and consuming **REST APIs**. * Experience working with **AWS cloud services**. * Knowledge of **GitHub Copilot** and modern software development practices. * Strong collaboration, communication, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment. This will help you stand out * Experience supporting applications within the **Distribution, Insurance, or Quoting** domain. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. * Exposure to application modernization and cloud\-native architectures. * Experience collaborating across distributed teams spanning multiple time zones. * Proven ability to manage and support application portfolios while balancing multiple priorities. Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary for this position is between $70,000 to $117,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance * Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off * 401(k) plan and contributions * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Stock Purchase Plan Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Java Developer – Cloud & Microservices
jobs.description: At Cognizant, our global community sets us apart—an energetic, collaborative and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. And with projects at the forefront of innovation, you can build a varied, rewarding career and draw inspiration from dedicated colleagues and leaders. Cognizant is right where you belong. **Job Summary** We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Java Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and cloud\-native technologies. This role will focus on building scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions that support critical business operations and digital transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in distributed systems, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, API development, and modern software engineering methodologies. This position requires close collaboration with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to deliver reliable and resilient enterprise applications. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Microservices architecture. * Build scalable, secure, and high\-performance backend services supporting business\-critical and high\-volume transaction processing systems. * Develop cloud\-native solutions leveraging Azure and other cloud platforms for compute, storage, networking, monitoring, and security services. * Design and implement distributed systems, service integration patterns, and event\-driven architectures to ensure availability, resiliency, and scalability. * Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and asynchronous integrations using technologies such as Kafka, JMS, RabbitMQ, or Azure Event Hub. * Apply object\-oriented design principles, software design patterns, and clean coding standards to build maintainable and extensible applications. * Implement automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing to ensure software quality and reliability. * Optimize application performance through code tuning, caching strategies, database optimization, and resource management. * Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering governance activities. * Implement observability and monitoring capabilities using logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and APM tools. * Support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to enable reliable releases and automated deployments. * Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement proactive improvements to enhance system stability and operational excellence. **Qualifications:** * 5–7 years of experience in enterprise software development with strong hands\-on expertise in Java\-based application development. * Strong proficiency in Java 8/11/17 and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and Spring Data. * Extensive experience designing and developing Microservices\-based architectures and RESTful APIs. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, API gateway patterns, service discovery, resiliency patterns, and event\-driven architecture. * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift. * Knowledge of messaging and streaming technologies including Kafka, JMS, RabbitMQ, or Azure Event Hub. * Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB. * Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps platforms. * Experience implementing automated testing using JUnit, Mockito, API testing tools, and software quality frameworks. * Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or Azure Application Insights. * Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, secure coding, communication, and problem\-solving skills. **\#LI\-EF1** **\#CB** **\#Ind123** Applications will be accepted until 12 Oct 2026\. **Salary and Other Compensation:** The annual salary for this position is between $\[113,000 \- 132,500] depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance * Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off * 401(k) plan and contributions * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Research & Engineering
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. **Overview** ============ This team, **AI Research \& Engineering (AIRE),** builds the applied machine learning systems that run our business at scale, from prototype to production. This role is ideal for a product manager who is equally comfortable sourcing training data and writing evals for our models, standing up production\-ready pipelines, and shipping tools that help internal teams make better decisions. You'll work across computer vision, structured data, and agentic AI workflows, with direct impact on products used by graders, researchers, and collectors. Every one of those products is only as good as the data behind it, and you'll own that data from first capture to final correction. As a **Staff Product Manager** , you'll decide what training data we collect, in what order, and how human corrections flow back into our models, partnering closely with ML Engineering and subject matter experts to improve model accuracy, development speed, and cost across the portfolio. You'll bring the technical fluency to earn credibility with engineers, the judgment to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategy, and the systems thinking to build feedback loops that make every model better than the last. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Set strategy and make the calls:** Define the strategy for our training data capabilities, prioritize what data we collect and when, and own decisions around quality, review depth, confidence thresholds, and cost. * **Build the data collection pipeline:** Own data collection end to end, including procurement, preparation, capture, expert labeling, and annotation, and build scalable systems across each stage. * **Optimize for throughput:** Coordinate work across teams and sites to maximize throughput, identify bottlenecks, and drive capacity planning across specialties and locations. * **Own human\-in\-the\-loop workflows:** Partner with subject matter experts and power users to define review processes and feedback loops that turn human corrections into valuable training data. * **Partner across functions:** Work closely with ML Engineering, Operations, and subject matter experts to set direction, align priorities, and drive execution without relying on direct authority. * **Measure and iterate:** Define the metrics that demonstrate data quality, model improvement, throughput, and cost efficiency, and communicate progress and tradeoffs to senior leadership. * **Raise the bar across Product:** Mentor other Product Managers, contribute to product practices, and build documentation and mechanisms that help scale product thinking across the organization. * **Build with AI:** Use emerging AI tools and coding agents, including Claude Cowork, Claude Code, and Codex, to accelerate product development, improve workflows, and find new ways to operate at scale. **Who You Are** =============== * **10\+ years of product management experience** , including experience building a product, platform, or capability from the ground up. * **Strategic and execution\-oriented:** You can set direction, make tradeoffs, influence operational decisions, and drive execution in ambiguous environments. * **Experience with AI** * **/ML or AI\-Enabled Operational Workflows:** You’ve worked on products where both models and human expertise play a role, and understand how to design workflows that leverage both effectively. * **Strong systems thinker:** You can identify constraints across complex, multi\-step workflows and understand how changes in one part of a system impact throughput, quality, and cost elsewhere. * **Comfortable owning business outcomes:** You’ve owned metrics tied to cost, efficiency, quality, or other measurable business outcomes and use data to drive decisions. * **Strong partner and influencer:** You build credibility with technical teams, operators, and subject matter experts and can influence effectively without direct authority. * **Hands\-on builder:** You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves to establish new processes, pipelines, documentation, and operating mechanisms. The first year will involve significant 0\-to\-1 work. * **Exceptional written communication:** You can clearly articulate strategy, plans, tradeoffs, and decisions for both technical and business audiences. * **Willingness to travel:** This role will require travel to multiple data collection sites, approximately **once per month to once per quarter** . **Salary Range** ================ The salary range for this position is **$165,848 \- $269,259** . Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, prior experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details. **Reasons To Join Us:** ======================= * **Health Insurance:** All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision * **Additional Benefits:** Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits. * **401(K) Matching Plan:** We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals * **Vacation:** All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off. * Holiday Pay: All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays * **Employee Discounts:** Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions * **Flexible Hours:** Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs * **Fun Working Environment:** Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.*

jobs.title: Manager, Marketplace Implementation
jobs.description: **Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era** ======================================= At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI\-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever\-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you. The **Manager of Marketplace Implementation** plays a key role within our Marketplace Services organization. This individual is responsible for leading the Marketplace Implementation team and overseeing the successful onboarding and launch of enterprise clients across supported eCommerce marketplaces. This role will manage people, processes, and implementation performance while ensuring clients receive a consistent, high\-quality onboarding experience. The Manager will work closely with Marketplace leadership and cross\-functional teams to manage client priorities, resolve escalations, improve onboarding processes, and ensure contractual service levels and implementation timelines are achieved. Strong marketplace knowledge, people leadership, operational management, and client relationship skills are essential for success in this role. **What You'll Do:** * Lead, coach, and develop Marketplace Implementation Managers, fostering team growth, accountability, operational excellence, and client success. * Oversee the end\-to\-end Marketplace onboarding and implementation process, ensuring enterprise clients are launched successfully and within established timelines and SLAs. * Manage team capacity and implementation assignments based on client complexity, team expertise, workload, and business priorities. * Serve as a primary escalation point for all complex client onboarding, implementation, and platform\-related issues. * Monitor implementation performance, client deadlines, onboarding volume, and SLA attainment to proactively identify risks and address potential delays. * Partner with Marketplace leadership, Sales Engineers, Sales to communicate implementation performance, capacity constraints, client risks, and opportunities for operational improvement. * Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Marketplace onboarding processes, documentation, best practices, and standard operating procedures. * Analyze trends across client requests, implementation challenges, and escalations to identify root causes and implement scalable solutions. * Identify platform or technical issues impacting client implementations and partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and other stakeholders to drive resolution. * Collaborate with Customer Success and other client\-facing teams to ensure alignment throughout the client onboarding journey and provide a seamless transition following implementation. * Lead team enablement and training for new marketplace integrations, platform capabilities, processes, and marketplace requirements. * Manage onboarding and training for new team members, ensuring consistent knowledge, expectations, and readiness to support enterprise clients. * Maintain strong knowledge of Feedonomics, FeedAMP, marketplace integrations, product feeds, and major eCommerce marketplace requirements. * Provide ongoing feedback to Marketplace leadership regarding team needs, tooling, training, process improvements, and opportunities to increase operational efficiency. Oversee team performance against contractual service delivery expectations and Marketplace implementation KPIs. * **Who You Are:** * 5\+ years of experience in marketplace implementation, marketplace feed management, eCommerce operations, account management, or a related discipline. * 3\+ years of direct people leadership, team leadership, or demonstrated experience coaching and developing employees. * Experience managing enterprise client onboarding, implementations, and escalations. * Hands\-on experience with major U.S. eCommerce marketplaces and their onboarding, catalog, product feed, and integration requirements. * Strong understanding of product data feeds, marketplace integrations, and eCommerce operations. * Experience managing team capacity, client deadlines, SLAs, and multiple concurrent implementations. * Demonstrated ability to identify operational trends, solve complex problems, and implement scalable process improvements. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with experience partnering with client\-facing, technical, product, and operational teams. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, team members, and senior leadership. * Strong client\-centric mindset with demonstrated ability to balance client needs, team capacity, and business priorities. * Experience with Feedonomics and/or FeedAMP preferred. * Excel, HTML, SQL, API, or related technical experience preferred. BA/BS degree in STEM or equivalent work experience. * \#LI\-KE1 \#LI\-Hybrid Pay Transparency Range: $62,166\.00 \- $105,135\.00 **Compensation Transparency** ============================= The national base salary range for this role is posted above in this job post. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams. Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution. **Inclusion and Belonging** =========================== At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive. jobs.description: **Title: Databricks Engineer** **Location: Remote in USA** Working hours in EST **Required certification: Active Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.** **Role Summary** The Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform running on Microsoft Azure, AWS or GCP. The role leverages Databricks, Python, PySpark, and SQL to deliver data ingestion, transformation, modeling, and pipeline orchestration. Working within the standards and designs set with the Senior Data Engineer, this role independently owns the delivery of assigned pipelines from development through production support. Lakeflow Jobs (formerly Databricks Workflows). * Implement data models within the lakehouse following medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and team modeling standards. * Apply Unity Catalog permissions and governance standards to the data assets you build. * Write unit and data quality tests and deploy pipelines through CI/CD using Git folders and Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles). * Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues in production. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to team documentation and engineering standards. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders and IT, to ensure data solutions meet business and performance requirements aligned to project goals. **Required Qualifications** **Experience** * 6\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data \& analytics or data warehousing. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with Databricks in a data engineering capacity. * 3\+ years of experience with Python, including manipulating large datasets using PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL, and/or the pandas API on Spark. * 2\+ years of data engineering experience on Microsoft Azure (e.g., ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault). **Skills and Knowledge** * Proficiency in Python programming for data engineering tasks. * Strong knowledge of SQL for data modeling, transformation, and querying. * Working knowledge of Delta Lake fundamentals (e.g., MERGE, schema evolution, time travel). * Working knowledge of Unity Catalog
