This is an excellent opportunity to join and grow EnSafe, getting involved in a variety of projects for a diverse range of clients across the globe. As a Staff Geologist, you will work alongside experienced geologists, engineers, and environmental scientists on a wide range of environmental consulting projects. This position offers hands\-on experience in environmental investigation, environmental due diligence, site characterization, remediation, and compliance projects while providing opportunities for professional growth and development. EnSafe emphasizes empowering staff to practice our profession passionately and without limitations. **DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES** ***In this role, you will:*** * Perform environmental field investigations involving soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment, soil vapor, and other media using approved sampling methods. * Support environmental site assessments, subsurface investigations, and site characterization activities. * Assist with soil logging, monitoring well installation oversight, groundwater gauging and sampling, and collection of environmental data. * Conduct field observations during remediation, construction, and environmental monitoring activities. * Support the operation, maintenance, and performance monitoring of remedial systems and pilot studies. * Maintain detailed and accurate field notes, boring logs, sampling records, and chain\-of\-custody documentation. * Interpret environmental and geological data to support project evaluations and technical recommendations. * Manage, organize, and summarize environmental datasets for project reporting and analysis. * Assist with the preparation of technical reports, work plans, regulatory submittals, and project correspondence. * Prepare maps, figures, and exhibits using GIS, database, and other technical software. * Collaborate with project teams to support environmental compliance, permitting, and remediation projects. * Demonstrate safe work practices and maintain compliance with health and safety requirements in both field and office environments. **SKILLS/EXPERIENCE** ***Minimum Skills and Requirements:*** * Bachelor's degree in Geology, Environmental Science, Hydrogeology, Earth Sciences, Geological Engineering, or a related environmental discipline. * 0\-2 years of relevant environmental consulting, geology, hydrogeology, or field investigation experience. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, organization, and time\-management abilities. * Ability to work independently under guidance from senior staff and contribute effectively within multidisciplinary teams. * Strong work ethic, initiative, adaptability, and willingness to learn. * Familiarity with environmental sampling techniques, field documentation, and environmental data interpretation. * Basic understanding of geology, hydrogeology, groundwater systems, and contaminant transport principles. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and technical data management. * Ability to meet physical job requirements, including: + Lifting up to 50 pounds. + Traversing uneven or rugged terrain. + Working outdoors in varying weather conditions. + Performing moderate physical activity for extended periods. * Ability to travel for field assignments, including occasional overnight stays. ***Preferred Skills*****:** * Master's degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, or a related discipline. * Experience with GIS software, environmental databases, or groundwater modeling tools. * OSHA 40\-Hour HAZWOPER certification. * Experience with environmental site assessments, groundwater monitoring, soil logging, or remediation projects. * Progress toward or interest in obtaining Geoscientist\-In\-Training certification and eventual Professional Geoscientist (PG) licensure in Texas **Why Join EnSafe?** * **Employee\-Owned Advantage** EnSafe is 100% employee\-owned, with an ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) since 1997\. We stress that *"safety is part of everything we do."* * **A Culture of Freedom \& Ownership** At EnSafe, our career philosophy is built on freedom. The freedom to take initiative, achieve your goals, and shape your own career path Employees are encouraged to pursue growth in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment. * **Challenging, Creative Work** Workdays at EnSafe are anything but ordinary, fast\-paced, dynamic, and filled with opportunities to tackle projects in environmental consulting, health \& safety, engineering, and technology. Every day calls for creativity, innovation, and agile problem\-solving. **\#LI\-CO1** **About EnSafe** EnSafe began as a two\-person firm in 1980, navigating complex regulatory compliance issues on behalf of our clients. The position carries responsibility for organic growth and for the profit and loss of the assigned unit. It also carries responsibility for operations and program areas including special projects, budget analysis, contract administration, and other specialized functions, and requires the preparation of reports intended to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of operations, as well as the coordination of assigned activities with other departments and divisions. The ideal candidate has previously established strong relationships with major participants in the industry, including large utilities, ISOs and RTOs, developers, and independent vendors, and is able to act as a representative of the Company by remaining conversant with the services and skills offered across all departments of the organization. Context for the search EnerNex holds established technical references in power quality engineering, ADMS advisory, grid modernization roadmaps, standards and interoperability, OT cybersecurity, and independent testing advisory through KEMA Laboratories. Adjacent capability includes large load and data center interconnection, DER interconnection, BESS validation, resilience and storm hardening, and regulatory and rate case support. The constraint on growth is origination rather than delivery capability. The Company is therefore establishing regionally based senior consulting positions. This appointment is the first of three planned regional positions. Territories are exclusive, and the subsequent appointments will not compete for the same accounts. Geographic focus Candidates are required to reside within one of the three target regions and to hold established client relationships within that region. The position is home\-based and remote working is supported within the United States. Relocation assistance is not provided, as the value of the appointment lies in the professional network already established in the territory. Region Priority Market rationale and principal accounts Texas First ERCOT interconnection queue and the large load and data center pipeline. Oncor, CenterPoint, AEP Texas, together with an extensive cooperative and municipal segment. Northeast Second Con Edison, National Grid, Eversource, and NYPA, together with the NYISO and ISO\-NE stakeholder processes. Midwest Third MISO footprint utilities, interconnection queue activity, and the cooperative and municipal segment across the region. Minimum qualifications The following three requirements are mandatory. All other provisions of this document are preferences. 1\. Technical consulting experience A minimum of ten years delivering paid consulting or advisory engagements to electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, or developers, in a scoping, technical lead, or engagement management capacity. The candidate must be able to describe engagements they personally scoped, priced, and stood behind technically. Candidates whose entire career has been internal to a single organization, without a period of external client delivery, do not satisfy this requirement. 2\. Established relationships with United States electric utilities The candidate must possess a substantial network of key contacts within the electric power industry, with focus on utilities, ISOs and RTOs, developers, vendors, and municipalities, at the level that awards consulting work. Relevant counterparts include vice presidents of engineering, directors of distribution and transmission planning, grid modernization program managers, and their equivalents at ISOs, RTOs, cooperatives, and municipal utilities. The candidate is expected to identify the accounts and to describe the most recent engagement sold into each. 3\. Demonstrated depth in at least one technical area The following list is stated in the alternative. A candidate is required to demonstrate depth in one area only, together with a working command of the remainder. * Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS) at utility scale. * Interconnection analysis and planning for a United States ISO or RTO, an electric utility, or a consulting firm. Application experience in at least one ISO or RTO is required, with ERCOT and MISO preferred. * Grid modernization program design and delivery, including distribution automation, ADMS, and utility enterprise architecture. * Transmission and distribution engineering services, including power system modeling and power market analysis. * AI feasibility and implementation in electric utilities Demonstrated depth in a si research and analysis of new programs, services, policies, and procedures, and prepares and presents reports. * Plans, coordinates, and evaluates activities associated with assigned contracts, participates in the research and evaluation of proposed contractual obligations and agreements, assists in contract negotiation and administration, and monitors compliance with applicable contractual agreements. * Provides highly responsible assistance to executive\-level management staff, including market and pipeline reporting. * Represents the Company within the assigned territory at state associations, ISO and RTO stakeholder processes, and industry conferences. * Coordinates and collaborates with departments, divisions, and outside agencies, including public and private organizations and industry bodies, and serves as a resource to them. * Coordinates with CESI Group affiliates where scope extends beyond the United States or into laboratory testing and certification. * Performs related duties as required. Compensation Base salary. A base salary determined by market value and experience, determined by record and by the substantiated size of the portfolio the candidate can bring. Variable compensation. An uncapped profit share on originated and completed work. The incumbent receives a share of cash collected on engagements they originate, on every project clearing an annual margin threshold measured across the portfolio as a whole rather than project by project. There is no ceiling, no discretionary element, and no retrospective adjustment. At a mature portfolio the variable component represents a six\-figure payment in addition to base salary. **In addition EnerNex offers a full suite of benefits including:** * Full paid medical and dental insurance on a high\-deductible plan that starts on the first day of the first full month of employment * Vision, well care, behavioral health and prescription drug plans * Life insurance at the rate of 1\.5 times salary * Short term disability insurance * Long term disability insurance * Accidental death and dismemberment insurance * Workman’s compensation * 8 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays * 4 weeks paid vacation/sick leave * Company paid society membership dues * Company paid professional license fees * Company sponsored 401k plan with 4% match Candidate sourcing Consulting experience is a mandatory qualification. Candidates are therefore to be sourced principally from consulting and engineering organizations serving the electric power sector: * Management and technology consultancies holding utility practices, including grid modernization, DER, metering, and enterprise advisory groups. * Transmission and distribution engineering firms, including interconnection study, system planning, and owner’s engineer practices. * Specialist power systems consultancies serving utilities, ISOs, RTOs, and developers. * Independent testing, certification, and technical advisory organizations serving the sector. Candidates presently employed by a utility, ISO, RTO, or developer remain within scope where their background includes a substantive period of external consulting delivery. The requirement is demonstrated consulting experience, not a current consulting employer. Priority is to be given to candidates whose client relationships sit within the target regions identified above. Recruiting partners are asked to identify, prior to submission, any client relationship that may present a conflict for EnerNex or for CESI Group affiliates. Administrative details * Target commencement date for the first appointment : on or before January 2027\. * Reporting line: President and CEO. * Travel expectation: 20%. * Work authorization and sponsorship position: US citizens and permanent residents only. * The company will consider remote working from the 3 geographic locations listed (United States only) Candidate submissions should be accompanied by the account summary described in item one of the screening criteria.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer: Computer Vision & 3D
jobs.description: ##### **Role Overview** FitMatch is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to advance the computer vision and 3D reconstruction behind QuadraScan, starting with improving how we reconstruct human geometry from ordinary camera images, focusing on geometric accuracy, reliable measurements, and real\-world performance. You'll own model development end to end, from data preparation and experimentation through evaluation and shipping, building on existing prototypes, datasets, and tools with real influence over our methods. This is a hands\-on senior IC role on a small team, reporting to the Head of Mobile Development. You'll align with them on objectives and trade\-offs while independently driving ML implementation and technical decisions. We expect strong, evidence\-backed recommendations and a track record of seeing work through to delivery. ##### **Location:** Remote ##### **Base salary:** $160,000–$200,000, depending on experience and work location ##### **Responsibilities:** * Own model development for human reconstruction and related computer vision work, from data preparation and training through evaluation and production integration * Select, adapt, and fine\-tune pretrained models, modifying architectures or training objectives when a clear product need justifies it * Design focused experiments with clear baselines, success criteria, and sensible time and compute limits * Improve training data and capture coverage across synthetic and real imagery, maintaining reliable labels, dataset versioning, and train/eval subject separation * Diagnose failures across the full pipeline, from capture quality and camera geometry to model predictions and reconstructed surfaces * Evaluate geometric fidelity, regional errors, robustness, and failure rates, tying model metrics to scan and measurement quality * Build maintainable training and inference code with reproducible experiments and practical regression checks * Partner with mobile and backend engineers to deploy improvements, balancing accuracy, latency, memory, and cost * Communicate findings clearly, including what the evidence supports, what remains uncertain, and the best next step ##### **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional experience in ML, computer vision, or related engineering, with substantial hands\-on model development * Proven track record taking a computer vision model from experimentation into production and improving it based on real\-world performance and failure cases * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including building training pipelines, modifying model components and losses, and diagnosing training issues * Practical experience with geometric computer vision (e.g., depth estimation, camera calibration, multi\-view geometry, 3D perception, or reconstruction) * Solid grasp of model evaluation, including overfitting, data leakage, distribution shift, and the limits of aggregate metrics * Strong software engineering fundamentals: maintainable code, version control, testing, debugging, and reproducible environments * Ability to turn ambiguous objectives into actionable technical plans and execute independently * Clear communication and sound judgment in balancing model quality, speed, and resources ##### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with human reconstruction, body shape, pose estimation, photogrammetry, or measurement\-sensitive vision applications, including work with point clouds, meshes, or differentiable rendering * Experience using synthetic data to improve transfer to real camera imagery, and adapting pretrained vision transformers or other large vision models to specialized tasks * Familiarity with deploying models on Apple platforms (Core ML, MLX, Metal) or other constrained devices * Experience delivering applied ML in a small company or a team with limited specialist support ##### **How We Work:** * We organize work around concrete product improvements, using experiments to drive decisions and following promising results through to reliable implementation. * Technical direction is collaborative. We value engineers who explain their reasoning, flag problems early, and push for better approaches when the evidence supports it. * We keep tooling proportionate to the work. Clear evaluation, reproducible results, and dependable delivery matter more than the size of the stack. * AI\-assisted engineering is standard at FitMatch. Tools like Claude Code are part of our daily workflow, and we expect engineers to use them thoughtfully while owning the correctness of the resulting code and conclusions.

jobs.title: Staff Data Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Faire** Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi\-hundred\-billion\-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. We're looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours. **About this role:** Our Engineering organization owns the software that makes our marketplace work. The Data Platform group supports everyone at Faire who depends on data: Product Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Strategy, Finance, and Product. Our job is to make sure the data is there, it's right, and people can find it and query it without having to think about the plumbing underneath. We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own that plumbing. Concretely, this means the path data takes out of our production databases (CockroachDB and MySQL) and into a place where analysts and data scientists can query it. Today that involves Fivetran, Kafka, Spark, and Airflow landing data in Snowflake and Databricks. It works, but it grew up over time and it shows. We want someone who can design the next version of it, build the hard parts personally, and bring the rest of the company along. This is a hands\-on role. You'll also be the person other teams come to when they need to know how data should move at Faire. **What you'll do:** * Set the technical direction for how data moves from production systems into our analytical stores, and own the roadmap to get there over the next couple of years. * Build the CDC and streaming ingestion layer: CockroachDB changefeeds and MySQL binlogs into Kafka, then into Iceberg tables on S3\. You'll be responsible for the hard details like ordering, deduplication, late data, schema changes, and backfills. * Implement data contracts and quality checks throughout our platform * Put real ownership and SLAs on the datasets the business runs on, and wire quality checks into the platform with tools like Anomalo and Monte Carlo so we hear about broken data before a dashboard or a model does. * Run Airflow and Fivetran well, and have an opinion about what we should keep buying versus what we should build. * Own reliability for the platform: SLOs, on\-call, incident reviews, and the follow\-through so the same thing doesn't break twice. * Work with the senior engineers, data scientists, and analysts who depend on this platform, and lead the migration of existing pipelines onto the new one without breaking what they rely on. * Mentor the engineers around you. We want the team's data engineering practice to be better because you were here. **Qualifications:** You've built and run data infrastructure that other teams depended on, at meaningful scale, and you've been the person setting direction for it, not just working on it. * Deep experience with change data capture and streaming ingestion from operational databases through Kafka. You know what goes wrong with ordering, duplicates, snapshots, and schema evolution because you've dealt with it. * Hands\-on experience with lakehouse architectures on an open table format. Iceberg on S3 is what we use, so that's especially valuable. You should be comfortable talking about partitioning, compaction, catalogs, and copy\-on\-write versus merge\-on\-read. * Strong Spark skills, and experience running Databricks and Snowflake against shared storage. * Experience with data quality and observability in practice, including data contracts, SLAs, and tools like Anomalo or Monte Carlo. * Experience operating Airflow at scale and working with managed ingestion like Fivetran. * Strong SQL, and good instincts for how to model data so analysts and data scientists can actually use it. * Solid Python plus at least one of Kotlin, Java, Scala, or Go. Experience shipping infrastructure on AWS with Terraform. * A working understanding of data governance: access control, PII, retention and deletion, lineage, and audit. * A track record of leading cross\-team data initiatives and migrations, and of mentoring senior engineers. * You can explain a technical tradeoff to a leadership team and to a new grad, and you can get people who disagree with each other to a decision. * You take ownership of things that are broken or unowned, and you're willing to be on call for the systems you build. * Experience in a marketplace, e\-commerce, or other transaction\-heavy business is a plus. **Technologies we use and teach:** * Python, Kotlin, SQL * Kafka, Fivetran, Airflow * S3, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark * AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes * CockroachDB, MySQL, Scylla and DynamoDB **Salary range:** San Francisco \& New York: the pay range for this role is $246,500 to $339,000 per year. This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future. *Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).* *Additionally, hybrid in\-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.* **Why you'll love working at Faire** * **Move fast:** You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly. * **Equipped to scale:** We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day. * **Best in class:** Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours. * **Real rewards.** Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work. * **Belonging:** We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success. Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We're backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener\-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog. Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form (https://bit.ly/faire\-form) **Privacy** For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire's Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

jobs.title: Data Software Engineer III
jobs.description: * Engineering * Atlanta ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI\-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e\-commerce, and beyond. **About the Role** We're looking for a Data Software Engineer to help build and scale the data infrastructure that powers our proprietary Large Market Model. You'll design and maintain the pipelines that ingest, process, and serve massive volumes of real\-time market information and data, giving our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engine the fuel they need to make decisions in real time. This is a high\-impact role at the intersection of data engineering and applied AI, working directly with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain scalable, low\-latency data pipelines that ingest live market information and data from diverse internal and external sources. * Develop robust ETL/ELT processes to clean, transform, and validate large\-scale, high\-velocity datasets feeding our proprietary Large Market Model. * Architect and optimize data storage solutions (data lakes, warehouses, streaming systems) for both real\-time and batch workloads. * Partner closely with data scientists and ML engineers to productionize models and ensure data is delivered in the right shape, at the right time, at scale. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost\-efficiency of production data systems. * Implement data quality, observability, and governance practices across the pipeline lifecycle. * Contribute to the evolution of our data platform architecture as Fetcherr scales across new airline customers and product lines. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-time experience as a Data Engineer, Software Engineer, or similar role focused on large\-scale data systems that are in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part\-time experiences do not apply to this experience. * Strong programming skills in Python, with production\-grade coding practices. * Strong SQL skills and experience with, relational and non\-relational data stores. * Experience and comfort with AI\-assisted software development, but also be able to write code yourself * Experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse \& data lakehouse technologies. * Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow \& Dagster) and CI/CD practices for data pipelines. * Experience operating high\-throughput, low\-latency systems in production. * Strong analytical mindset, attention to data quality, and a pragmatic, get\-it\-done engineering approach. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross\-functionally with data science and product teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience working with real\-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse * Experience in travel, e\-commerce, logistics, or other dynamic\-pricing/real\-time\-decisioning domains * Experience in Software\-As\-A\-Service environment * Exposure to machine learning pipelines or MLOps practices.

jobs.title: Strategic Solutions Engineer - CNC - Boston, MA
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. ### **Impact In This Role** Misumi Americas is seeking a Strategic Solutions Engineer \- CNC to join our solution engineering team focused on strategic, high\-complexity, production\-level customer programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, customer advisory, and commercial execution, supporting customers as they scale from prototype into production. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in CNC machining, casting, CAD, (SolidWorks), GD\&T, and DFM skills,strong technical communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through DFM/DFA, production readiness, operational/program support, cost optimization, and mechanical assembly considerations. This role is mainly customer\-facing and requires comfort operating in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments. ### **What You'll Be Doing** **Customer \& Program/Production Support** * Serve as a trusted technical advisor/guide for strategic customers with complex CNC manufacturing needs. * Lead technical scoping discussions, translating customer requirements into manufacturable, scalable solutions. * Some level of support for customers through prototype production transitions, anticipating manufacturing risks early. **Manufacturing \& DFM Expertise** * Perform detailed DFM/DFA reviews for CNC\-machined components. * Evaluate part geometry, tolerances, GD\&T, material selection, and finish requirements for manufacturability and cost. * Provide cost optimization recommendations based on process selection, feature simplification, and volume scaling. * Support efforts with manufacturing\-informed input on feasibility, risk, and lead time. **Assembly \& System\-Level Understanding/Support** * Evaluate and guide on mechanical assemblies, including: * + Part\-to\-part fit, stack\-ups, and tolerance interactions + Fastener selection, joint design, and access for assembly + Assembly sequencing and installation considerations * Help customers identify risks related to assembly, serviceability, and field installation. * Provide feedback that improves downstream assembly efficiency and reduces rework. **Technical Execution** * Review and interpret engineering drawings with strong command of GD\&T. * Perform CAD work, including: * + Design updates for manufacturability + Parametric 3D Modeling \& Visualization + Detailed Documentation \& Drafting with GD\&T + Optimizing CAD — CNC to Casting and 3DP to IM + Reverse engineering * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Operations, Quality, and LoB teams. **Quality \& Compliance Awareness** * Apply working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements in customer discussions and internal workflows. * Identify quality risks early and ensure proper requirements definition ("quality in, quality out"). ### **Desired Traits** * 6\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing roles such as CNC (candidates with deeper experience are strongly encouraged to apply). * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent demonstrated hands\-on experience. * Strong expertise in CNC machining processes (milling, turning, multi\-axis) and Casting, . * Must have DFM, cost optimization, and manufacturing trade\-off fluency. * Hands\-on experience in production\-scale manufacturing programs. * Proven ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings and GD\&T. * Solid understanding of mechanical assemblies and installation considerations. * Experience supporting customer\-facing technical discussions. * Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D compliance environments. * Willingness and ability to travel 30–40%. * Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office. * Strong verbal, written, and digital communication skills. * SolidWorks CAD proficiency. * Willingness to perform hands\-on CAD work and reverse engineering as needed. * Willingness to support the Marketing team with technical publications, seminars, university lectures, and other related activities as needed. ### **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** * Experience with Casting, Molding (IM) and/or Additive Manufacturing (3DP). * Prior experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers. * Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude and other AI assistants) to accelerate DFM analysis, documentation, customer\-facing content creation, and day\-to\-day engineering workflows. * Experience integrating AI/LLM tools into engineering or customer\-facing workflows. ### **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Standard Office \& Remote Work: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for remote customer consultations. * Onsite Environments: Must be able to walk and stand on manufacturing floors and trade show environments for extended periods. Must be able to safely navigate industrial areas around heavy machinery and wear required PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection). * Lifting \& Handling: Ability to occasionally lift, move, and position mechanical parts, prototypes, or trade show materials weighing up to 30 lbs. ### **Perks and Benefits** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401K plan * Parental leave programs * Paid volunteer days * And much, much more! **Salary Range: $125,000 to $142,000 per year, based upon experience** **Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

We are currently sourcing for a Full Stack AI Engineer to work in Covington, KY! **Full Stack AI Engineer** This is a unique Greenfield opportunity to help build a brand\-new AI engineering organization focused on delivering innovative AI solutions that enhance the advisor and client experience across Fidelity Wealth. The team's mission is to leverage artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and large language models (LLMs) to solve real business problems, streamline advisor workflows, reduce administrative overhead, and help advisors spend more time delivering value to clients. **The Expertise You Bring** As an early member of this organization, you will play a key role in designing, building, and delivering AI\-powered solutions from concept through production. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate closely with business partners, product teams, architects, data scientists, and fellow engineers to identify high\-value opportunities and develop secure, scalable, enterprise\-grade AI capabilities that drive important business outcomes. Successful candidates will possess strong technical expertise and a passion for building innovative solutions, working with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into practical AI applications. The ideal individual enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing production\-ready systems, and contributing to the evolution of modern AI platforms and capabilities. **Example Use Cases** Representative initiatives may include developing AI\-powered capabilities that improve advisor effectiveness and client engagement, such as: * Automated meeting preparation and research * Intelligent call summarization and insight generation * Automated follow\-up and workflow orchestration * Knowledge retrieval and recommendation systems * AI\-assisted decision support and productivity tools * Workflow automation leveraging enterprise data sources and communication channels **The Skills You Bring** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 3\+ years of software engineering experience. * Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, production\-grade software solutions and distributed systems. * Experience using LLMs and Generative AI technologies to tackle real business challenges * Full\-stack engineering background with modern languages and frameworks such as Python, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, React, and Next.js. * Hands\-on experience deploying and scaling applications within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Experience with modern platform engineering and DevOps practices, including containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cloud\-native architectures. * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, security, and reliability principles for enterprise\-scale applications. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, sound technical judgment, and a passion for building innovative solutions. * Ability to collaborate optimally across engineering, data, product, and business teams while driving initiatives from concept to production. Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement\-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self\-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. We are proud of our diverse and inclusive workplace where we respect and value our associates for their unique perspectives and experiences. For information about working at Fidelity, visit FidelityCareers.com. Fidelity Investments is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Associate Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Associate Mechanical Engineer** Fike Corporation, a rapidly growing international manufacturer of pressure relief, explosion protection, fire suppression and detection equipment, has an opportunity for an Associate Mechanical Engineer position. Fike is a privately held business located in Blue Springs, MO with over 400 employees locally \& over 1,200 employees worldwide. **Job Summary:** Assists the Engineering organization in developing new systems and components for fire and explosion suppression and pressure relief industry in accordance with product requirements. Provides technical support to engineers, Operations, Sales and Marketing. Using established procedures, makes calculations to obtain necessary engineering parameters and conducts routine experiments and research to understand physical phenomena of our products. Relies upon more experienced co\-workers for guidance in resolving challenging problems. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Performs engineering design and analysis functions in response to specific product validation tests, failure analyses, and basic research. * Confers with other engineers, Sales, Production and Quality to clarify or resolve problems. * Performs laboratory experiments to determine necessary engineering parameters. Discusses, analyzes, summarizes and publishes test results. Uses test data and reports to determine if design meets functional and performance specifications. Evaluates test results for possible application to development of other uses. * Prepares product or system layouts, detailed drawings and schematics. Performs project and system design. * Uses computer assisted engineering and design software and equipment to perform engineering and design tasks. * Confers with other engineering personnel and prepares design modifications as required. * May make recommendations to appropriate personnel on improvements to current production processes leading to increased efficiency. * Coordinates activities with appropriate approval agencies to ensure compliance of new products with industry standards. * Coordinates completion of all documents required to produce new products including the creation of assembly drawings, bills of materials, Fike business system item masters and any other documentation required.\- * Provides engineering and manufacturing support on new and/or existing products when problems arise with manufacturing or approval processes. * May interact with customers to provide engineered solutions to their requirements and product problems. * Provides support in calculations and application information. * Studies ASME, ANSI, MIL, AISI, IFI, NACE, API, AWS and NFPA standards. Applies these standards as appropriate to new designs. * Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops and seminars, reviewing professional publications, networking and participating in professional societies. * Adheres to the Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) policies and procedures related to NIST 800\-171 and completes all required CUI Awareness training, which includes collection, processing/handling, transmission, storage, and general safeguarding practices. * Maintains the confidentiality of all information processed. *Performs related duties as assigned. Regular and consistent attendance is required.* **Critical Skills:** Subject Matter Understanding. Analytical. Computer Applications. Design. Research. Project Management. Critical Thinking. Problem Solving. **Job Qualifications:** **Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline. Experience with CAD. Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills. 0 \- 2 years post graduate experience. **Preferred:** Preparing for the engineering\-in\-training certification. Experience with Inventor 3\-D design software. Background in fluid flow, thermodynamics, metallurgy, or stress analysis using finite element methods. **Compensation:** The pay range for this position is $61,099 to $76,392 a year. May increase depending on the level of experience of the candidate. **Working at Fike** At Fike, our people are our strength. In order to fulfill our greatest potential, we are committed to attracting, growing and retaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. Better, Together as OneFike! Plus, at Fike, we offer benefits and perks to help make you smile and feel like family. Check out our competitive benefits package which includes: * Three Weeks Paid Time Off (PTO) pro\-rated the first year \& Paid Holidays * Medical Plans with FSA \& HSA, Vision \& Dental Plan * Paid Life and Long\-term Disability Insurance * 401(k) and Roth 401(k) Plan with Company Match Fully Vested on Day One! * Profit Sharing Bonus Program * Education Reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program * On\-Site Fitness Center \& Award Winning Wellness Program * Reimbursement for Safety Shoes \& Glasses * Service awards \& Recognition Program * Company Picnic, Quarterly Events and Holiday Lunch Free Coffee/Tea, Lunch Utensils, Lunch Room Mini\-mart, Free Parking * Refer to Req ID 3953\. Please visit our website at www.fike.com to fill out an application. *Fike is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **Why this role matters** ------------------------- First Resonance builds the ION Factory OS — the operating system powering next\-generation manufacturing for companies building rockets, satellites, eVTOLs, clean energy systems, robotics, and autonomous vehicles. Our customers generate critical data across ION, ERP, PLM, quality, finance, procurement, equipment, and homegrown systems. That data only creates value when it is trustworthy, connected, and available at the moment a factory team needs to make a decision. We are hiring a **Forward Deployed Engineer, Data** to turn fragmented manufacturing data into durable, production\-grade data products and pipelines. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role. You will work directly with customer data, manufacturing, and IT teams and partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Engineering. You will move from an ambiguous operational question to a deployed solution — designing the architecture, writing production code, validating the data, launching with users, and keeping it reliable. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **Deliver customer data solutions end to end:** Lead discovery, requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, go\-live, documentation, and operational handoff for high\-value customer use cases. * **Build reliable data pipelines:** Ingest, transform, reconcile, and serve data across ION and customer systems using APIs, webhooks, event streams, batch workflows, and modern data tooling. * **Model complex manufacturing operations:** Translate parts, bills of materials, work orders, inventory, quality, labor, costs, and engineering changes into clear and maintainable data models. * **Make data trustworthy:** Establish validation, observability, lineage, access controls, retry and backfill patterns, and incident\-response practices so customers can depend on production data. * **Turn deployments into product leverage:** Convert successful customer work into reusable pipelines, semantic models, reference architectures, test harnesses, runbooks, and platform improvements. * **Lead through ambiguity:** Set expectations with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, surface risks early, make practical tradeoffs, and remain accountable for the customer outcome. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or another role building production data systems. * Strong programming ability in Python and fluency with SQL, data modeling, and software\-engineering practices such as testing, version control, and code review. * Experience building and operating data pipelines across APIs, transactional databases, event streams, object storage, and cloud data platforms. * Sound judgment around distributed\-system and data\-quality failure modes, including idempotency, ordering, schema evolution, reconciliation, observability, and access control. * Ability to work directly with customers, turn ambiguous operational problems into clear technical plans, and communicate tradeoffs to both engineers and business leaders. If you do four of these five things well, we encourage you to apply. We care more about evidence of ownership, learning, and shipped outcomes than a perfect keyword match. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with manufacturing, supply\-chain, ERP, PLM, MES, quality, or industrial data. * Experience with AWS and modern data technologies such as dbt, Airflow or Dagster, Kafka or similar event systems, and cloud warehouses or lakehouses. * Experience designing metrics layers, analytical data products, or operational reporting used by frontline teams. * Familiarity with enterprise security, regulated environments, air\-gapped networks, or customer\-managed infrastructure. * Experience in a customer\-facing technical role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or implementation engineering. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health Insurance; medical, vision, dental, \& life insurance. * Paid Parental Leave. * Employee Stock Option Plan. * Team outings, group lunches, open office, happy hours. * Paid holidays, sick days. * Flexible Friday and PTO. * 401K. *First Resonance is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce.* *First Resonance participates in E\-Verify. As part of our onboarding process, a new hire's Form I\-9 information will be shared with the federal government to confirm they are authorized to work in the U.S.* *Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location.* *First Resonance accelerates the speed and reliability of hardware development for companies manufacturing the next generation of hardware products. This includes space exploration, electric airplanes, autonomous vehicles, nuclear reactors, robotics, and more. We are a group of software, hardware, and manufacturing engineers that are bringing the best of modern UX and data science to an industry that has been overly rigid in its innovation. We are removing the barriers preventing radical advancement by providing tools to manufacturing engineers and operators to move information more freely, collaborate with their teams more easily, and use the power of data to predict problems and provide insights that result in better hardware quality and delivery.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About The Position** Our mission is to connect constituencies to their elected representatives at all levels of government, and as a member of our engineering team, you will play a crucial role in delivering first\-rate customer service to our many clients. You’ll have the potential to be working anywhere in the stack, from creating delightful front\-end user experiences and improving upon existing and building new backend functionality and internal APIs. This position supports delivery of projects end\-to\-end under the guidance and support of experienced team members. Your specific mission is to help our front\-line support team solve technical client issues, providing timely solutions and escalating problems to the full development team. You should feel comfortable handling tickets, learning about new software, and communicating with both our support and development teams. You will also be instrumental in helping set up and maintain our production servers. **About The Team** Fireside provides software\-based communications solutions to Members of Congress and state and local representatives and entities that allow their teams to work smarter, reach further, and discover more. Every day, we help our clients foster stronger connections. https://www.fireside21\.com/ Our team has a wealth of diverse life and career experiences that allow us to think outside of the box and ahead of the curve. You will get the opportunity to drive the future through new products that delight, while working with a mix of product, design, application engineers, data engineers, and AI experts to devise, nurture, and implement cutting\-edge solutions to continuously evolving engineering obstacles. **About You** Motivated. Collaborative. Eager to learn. Excellent communicator. You’re ready to build your skills in web technologies and contribute to meaningful projects. You’re excited to work in a team environment, sharing ideas and solutions with colleagues, and you thrive on the challenge of meeting evolving client needs to achieve bold results. You relish the challenge of helping our clients accomplish their design goals while pushing them to consider and advocating for modern web design, user\-experience, and accessibility standards and initiatives. ***Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Advanced Manufacturing \& Automation Engineer** **Location: Kalamazoo, MI** **Shape the Future of Manufacturing** We are seeking an innovative and hands\-on **Advanced Manufacturing \& Automation Engineer** who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and transforming ideas into practical manufacturing solutions. This role offers the opportunity to influence how we machine, automate, program, and optimize production processes while working closely with operations, engineering, and technology teams. If you enjoy being at the intersection of CNC machining, automation, continuous improvement, and emerging technologies, we encourage you to apply. **What You'll Do** As an Advanced Manufacturing \& Automation Engineer, you will: * Develop, optimize, and support 5\-axis CNC machining processes. * Create, troubleshoot, and improve CNC programs and post\-processors for complex machining applications. * Lead and support automation initiatives across manufacturing operations. * Collaborate with machinists, operators, programmers, engineers, and production leaders to solve technical challenges. * Improve manufacturing efficiency through setup reduction, process optimization, machine utilization improvements, and workflow enhancements. * Support palletized machining systems and automated manufacturing technologies. * Use ESPRIT EDGE to develop advanced machining strategies and CNC programs. * Utilize SOLIDWORKS to design fixtures, manufacturing concepts, and process improvements. * Support new equipment installations, machine validations, process development, and technology implementation projects. * Explore and implement innovative digital solutions, including AI, scripting, automation, and data\-driven manufacturing tools. * Drive projects from problem identification through deployment and long\-term sustainability. **What We're Looking For** We're interested in candidates who bring a combination of technical expertise, curiosity, and a passion for manufacturing innovation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in CNC machining, manufacturing engineering, or advanced manufacturing environments. * Hands\-on experience with 5\-axis machining and/or CNC programming. * Experience supporting manufacturing automation systems and process integration. * Familiarity with Mazak machining centers is highly valued. * Experience with pallet automation systems or automated machining cells. * Working knowledge of ESPRIT EDGE and/or other CAM programming software. * Experience using SOLIDWORKS or similar CAD platforms. * Knowledge of CNC post\-processor development, modification, or troubleshooting. * Experience with robotics, machine tending, automated material handling, or industrial automation is a plus. * Exposure to AI, coding, scripting, digital manufacturing tools, or Industry 4\.0 technologies is highly desirable. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in manufacturing engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent technical training, military experience, apprenticeship programs, or relevant manufacturing experience will also be considered. * Demonstrated success solving manufacturing problems and driving measurable improvements is highly valued. **What Makes You Successful** You may be a great fit if you: * Take ownership of challenges and drive solutions to completion. * Enjoy working directly with equipment, manufacturing processes, and production teams. * Are naturally curious and continuously seek opportunities to learn and improve. * Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization. * Build strong partnerships and collaborate well across cross\-functional teams. * Embrace new technologies and innovative approaches to manufacturing. * Balance speed, quality, and long\-term sustainability when solving problems. * Enjoy turning technical concepts into practical operational improvements. **Why Join Flowserve?** This role offers a unique opportunity to directly influence the future of manufacturing within Flowserve. Your work will help shape how we: * Program and optimize advanced CNC machining operations. * Expand automation and smart manufacturing capabilities. * Implement emerging technologies and AI\-driven solutions. * Improve operational efficiency, quality, and productivity. * Develop scalable manufacturing processes for future growth. You'll join a team that values innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence while creating real impact on the shop floor. **Our Commitment to Inclusion** Flowserve is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds are valued. Even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique skills and experiences may make you an excellent fit for this role.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid At Ford, we are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. Every day, we roll up our sleeves to build a better world—together. We are part of something bigger, reshaping the way the world moves through innovation, passion, and dedication. Are you ready to join us and leave your mark on the future of mobility? Ford’s Advanced Technology \& Platforms (ATP) team is seeking a highly motivated Manufacturing Software Engineer to develop and deploy mission\-critical diagnostic, testing, and quality software for current and next\-generation Ford and Lincoln vehicles. In this role, you’ll build software that connects in\-vehicle systems with modern manufacturing operations. You’ll work across the stack—from native applications on Android Automotive OS (AAOS) in the Ford infotainment ecosystem to enterprise cloud services—to help ensure vehicle quality as vehicles move through Ford assembly plants around the world. **Manufacturing Software \& Vehicle Quality** * Design, develop, test, and deploy robust full\-stack applications that support end\-of\-line vehicle quality and diagnostic verification across Ford’s global assembly plants. * Develop, optimize, and maintain vehicle\-level applications and background services on Android Automotive OS using Java and Kotlin, tailored to the Ford infotainment ecosystem. * Work directly with plant engineers, quality teams, and assembly operations to understand plant\-floor challenges and turn them into practical, high\-impact software solutions. * Collaborate with stakeholders across vehicle software architecture, connected vehicle platforms, cloud engineering, and manufacturing IT. * Own feature delivery from requirements and technical specifications through implementation, testing, and validation in vehicles and simulated plant environments. * Demonstrate working software, enhancements, and prototypes to technical peers, plant leadership, and business stakeholders. **Engineering Quality \& Delivery** * Apply modern software engineering practices, including automated unit and instrumentation testing, code coverage, static analysis, and CI/CD. * Help ensure software deployments are reliable and suitable for quality\-critical manufacturing operations. * Work in a fast\-paced Agile environment, contributing to iterative development and continuous improvement. * Use work item tracking, defect management, and test lifecycle tools—including Jira and Xray—to support execution, test plans, and requirements traceability. * Create clear requirements and technical documentation using collaboration tools such as Confluence. * Communicate technical concepts, delivery progress, and software demonstrations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Android \& AAOS Development** * Build vehicle\-facing applications and services using Java and modern Kotlin, including Jetpack Compose, MVVM/MVI patterns, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, and dependency\-injection frameworks such as Dagger or Hilt. * Work with the Vehicle Hardware Abstraction Layer (VHAL) and Android system services to monitor vehicle signals and execute vehicle actions. * Develop privileged, system\-level, or platform\-signed Android applications; define custom permissions; and implement inter\-process communication using AIDL and Binder. * Use the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) build system and debugging tools such as logcat, systrace, and Perfetto to investigate performance issues, ANRs, and native crash tombstones. * Develop automated unit and instrumentation tests using tools such as JUnit, Espresso, and Robolectric, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines for emulators and physical target hardware. * Promote code quality and maintainability through tools such as SonarQube, Spotless, Android Lint, and JaCoCo. **Cloud, Connected Vehicle \& Systems Integration** * Apply familiarity with the Ford Telematics Communication Protocol (FTCP) to support vehicle\-to\-cloud messaging and data exchange. * Work with cloud technologies—preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP)—to support connected vehicle data pipelines, backend services, and plant quality telemetry. * Contribute to modern software engineering practices, including continuous integration and continuous deployment automation. We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you’re passionate about automotive software, manufacturing technology, and building reliable solutions that improve vehicle quality, we encourage you to apply. **Education** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. **Experience** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering e sonal skills, including the ability to demonstrate working software and explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. **Android \& AAOS Development Expertise** * Strong proficiency in Android development using Java and modern Kotlin, including Jetpack Compose, MVVM/MVI, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, and dependency\-injection frameworks such as Dagger or Hilt. * Hands\-on experience with VHAL and underlying Android system services. * Experience building privileged, system\-level, or platform\-signed Android applications, defining custom permissions, and implementing AIDL and Binder communication. * Familiarity with AOSP builds and advanced debugging, including logcat, systrace, Perfetto, ANR analysis, and native crash tombstones. * Experience developing automated unit and instrumentation tests with JUnit, Espresso, or Robolectric, and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines for emulators and physical hardware. * Experience with static analysis, formatting, and coverage tools such as SonarQube, Spotless, Android Lint, and JaCoCo. **Preferred Experience** * Familiarity with the Ford Telematics Communication Protocol (FTCP). * Experience with GCP, connected vehicle data pipelines, backend services, or plant quality telemetry. * Experience developing backend microservices using Java and Spring Boot. * Familiarity with data serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers (Protobuf). * Experience with messaging protocols such as MQTT and REST, and cloud services such as Cloud Run and BigQuery. You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! **As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:** * Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members, and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. **For a detailed look at our benefits, click here:** Benefit Summary This position is a salary grade**6\-7**. This position is a salary grade **6\-7** and ranges from **$74,300****\-****$144,900**. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. ***\* Please note: This is a hybrid role, you are expected to relocate if you are not within commutable distance, and responsible to be onsite 4 days per week*** **\*** ***\*Visa Sponsorship is not provided for this role*****\*** Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, If you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-GH2

jobs.title: Engineer I - Water
jobs.description: Start your engineering career by doing engineering. We know you have the knowledge. We will show you how you can use it. As an Engineer I at Freese and Nichols, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers, get regular feedback, and have mentors and teammates you can turn to as you build your skills on real projects that shape how communities move, grow and manage water. With their guidance, you will build your technical skills, see your work in the field, and work towards your EIT/EI and PE. We have a great opportunity for **December 2026, May 2027, and August 2027** **new grads** to launch their careers! You will work in **Water Transmission and Utilities, Stormwater, and Water/Wastewater Master Planning.** This opportunity is available in **Denver, CO** . **What you will do –** * Develop design plans, support hydraulic calculations and drainage studies, analyze data, build models, and help prepare technical reports and construction documents * Build and review models using industry\-standard engineering software * Work with experienced engineers who will explain the “why”, not just give you a task * Visit project sites and see how designs move from plans to reality * Gradually take ownership of portions of real project deliverables **What we will do for you –** We're all about **flexibility** , **growth** , and **community** here. We offer a flexible work schedule and you can **work from home up to two days a week** . We will help you **obtain your EIT/EI and PE** with a test prep platform, paid day off for test days, and bonuses for passing the exams. As you build experience and progress toward your PE, you'll have opportunities to take on greater technical responsibility, work directly with clients and grow into project leadership. You will receive training in engineering software, technical communication, project delivery and professional skills, with opportunities to learn from engineers across the firm. Plus, you can join **Rise and Thrive** , our Young Professionals group, to grow your network, level up your career, and hang out at fun social events. **If you apply, here’s what happens next –** We will share your resume with the hiring manage. jobs.title: Contact Center Data Analytics Engineer I
jobs.description: **Why Join GEICO?** At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities. Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers. The Contact Center Data Analytics Engineer I plays a critical role in improving contact center performance by turning operational, customer, and system data into reliable insights, reporting, and automation opportunities. This role supports the analytics needs of contact center operations, interactive voice response (IVR), self\-service, workforce management, product, and technology partners. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with practical business judgment and can use data to proactively identify issues, explain performance trends, and recommend actions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. This is a hybrid position, requiring on\-site presence 2\-3 days a week at one of the following locations: Dallas, TX; Palo Alto, CA; Bethesda, MD; Buffalo, NY; San Diego, CA; Virginia Beach, VA; Fredericksburg, VA; Tampa, FL. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, test, deploy, and maintain data structures, enterprise reports, dashboards, data visualizations, analytical systems, and recurring performance reporting. * Analyze contact center, IVR, digital, customer, and operational data to identify trends, root causes, performance gaps, and opportunities for automation or process improvement. * Build and maintain reporting using Power BI, SQL, Amazon QuickSight, Amazon CloudWatch, and other approved analytics tools used by the team. * Monitor key operational metrics and proactively identify emerging issues, including changes in call volume, containment, transfer behavior, speed of answer, abandonment, handle time, call drivers, and customer experience indicators. * Partner with operations, workforce management, IVR, automation, product, technology, data architecture, and data governance teams to understand business problems, define requirements, and design practical data solutions. * Research and query structured and unstructured data sources to understand how systems work, validate data quality, and expand available reporting and insight capabilities. * Create clear documentation for code, reporting logic, metric definitions, source systems, data structures, and operational assumptions. * Serve as a data steward for assigned subject areas, helping ensure data is accurate, available, properly classified, and governed appropriately. * Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, translating complex data into practical business recommendations. **Required Qualifications** * 1\+ years of experience in business analytics, data analytics, product analytics, operations analytics, or a related analytical role. * 1\+ years of experience querying complex data sets using SQL and performing data analysis. * 1\+ years of experience using analytical or programming languages such as Python, R, SAS, .NET, M, or DAX. * Experience developing reporting or data visualizations in Power BI, Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools. * Ability to work with large and complex data sets, validate results, and explain findings in a clear and business\-focused way. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, follow established processes, learn technical concepts quickly, and work effectively in a cross\-functional environment. * BA/BS degree or equivalent experience in computer science, statistics, analytics, operations research, economics, mathematics, business, or a related field. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting contact center, IVR, customer service, workforce management, digital servicing, insurance, or financial technology environments. * Experience using Amazon CloudWatch or similar monitoring tools to identify system, service, or operational anomalies. * Experience working in an Agile environment with product, engineering, or technology teams. * Working knowledge of data governance, metric definition, data quality validation, and documentation practices. * Interest in automation, self\-service improvement, and translating analytics into measurable business value. **Annual Salary** $79,950\.00 \- $141,450\.00 The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. support for special projects or initiatives as directed by management * Complete other duties that may be assigned as required with consideration for quality, safety and efficiency Assembly * Assist in the setup and installation of computer server racks according to provided instructions * Help in the assembly of server racks by following diagrams and guidelines provided by senior team members * succeed at GXO:**At a minimum, you’ll need: * To be at least 18 years of age * High school diploma or equivalent * 1 year of experience in logistics, inventory management, or related fields * material handling equipment such as forklifts pallet jacks It’d be great if you also have: * Additional education or certification in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field * Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment * Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively and safely in a team setting * Ensure a positive, respectful, and professional attitude if everything you do * Availability to work a flexible schedule, including possible overtime when needed This job requires the ability to: * Ability to lift and move heavy material and perform physical tasks related to handling server trays and server racks * Use power equipment to assist the team with safely moving very heavy server racks into position in accordance with established protocols and safety guidelines * Carry objects 3\-5 feet weighing up to 50 lbs, routinely * Stand for prolonged periods of time \>4 hours * Walk continuously for more than 10,000 steps (4\-5\) miles per day * Bend, stoop, squat, twist, push and pull objects of various shapes and sizes in team lift. * Tolerate
