jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers. (\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026\)**Day to Day** -------------- You'll own capabilities at the foundation of how the company moves, stores, and reasons about data: collecting analytical events in real time and batch, housing them cost\-efficiently across thousands of datasets, and making them queryable at massive scale. Your focus is building paved paths, opinionated end\-to\-end workflows, that let teams produce trusted data outcomes without stitching together systems, filing tickets, or becoming amateur platform engineers. You'll be accountable for the full user\-facing capability across whatever products it touches, absorbing the friction from start to finish. You'll build these paths alongside your customers, working with engineers on the technical design and with internal users, so decisions rest on real use cases and direct feedback. Expect to stay hands\-on: tracing how data flows end\-to\-end, finding where paths break down, and shifting more of the work from procedural steps to simple, declarative intent. Making the platform AI\-ready is core to the role. You'll shape how data is exposed to AI systems and agents through natural\-language access, programmatic access, and AI\-assisted analysis, and you'll hold those capabilities to the same governance, quality, and observability bar as everything else. You're also expected to use AI fluently in your own work: speeding up discovery and analysis, prototyping and pressure\-testing ideas, drafting specs, synthesizing customer feedback, and automating workflows so you spend more time on the product strategy.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with engineering teams and other interested parties to prioritize and manage roadmaps for delivering toward product vision incrementally and efficiently. * Communicate roadmap and product plan to and get alignment with leadership, collaborators and interested parties. * Be the face of the customer internally, advocating for, and representing their needs, opportunities, and product requirements. * Identify, and monitor product goals and success metrics. * Iterate quickly to launch new features and make data\-driven judgments to test their efficacy. * Provide clear written and verbal updates on the roadmap and progress toward goals to leadership and collaborators. **Skills/Competencies** ----------------------- * Requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience * Excellent written and verbal communication in English * Experience working closely with engineers to define, plan, and build products and features * Data\-driven mindset * Deep curiosity and accountability for the data and insights of their products. **Salary Range Transparency** ----------------------------- Tier 2 \- United States of America 96,000 \- 144,000 USD per year**Salary Range Disclaimer** --------------------------- *At this time, we are not considering candidates for this role who are based in the following locations: Austin, TX* The salary range for this role reflects the minimum and maximum compensation for the role. For more information, select your country and learn more about our employee benefits, program, \& perks at https://www.indeed.com/careers/benefits!**Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement** ---------------------------------------------------- Indeed is deeply committed to building a workplace and global community where inclusion is not only valued, but prioritized. jobs.title: Manager, Systems Analysis (Robotic Algorithms and Control)
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB218544 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position:** Systems Analysts (Robotic Control Engineers) at Intuitive Surgical perform a central role in the design, development, and support of new products in the daVinci Surgery product lines. Systems Analysts are primarily responsible for the tele\-robotic motion \& force control algorithms, robotic manipulator control, and safety algorithms for new surgical robots, instruments, accessories, and endoscopes. This responsibility crosses into electrical, mechanical, software, control, user interface, and safety engineering where all the subsystems are integrated together. Systems Analysts strive to provide early design input, quickly prove out new designs, and seek out solutions to subtle and challenging problems in system integration, system safety, and motion \& force control. Responsibilities continue until the products are shipping to customers with the highest quality and reliability. The Manager of a System Analysis team establishes the individual responsibility within their team, towards projects needing motion \& force control algorithms and safety systems. They are responsible for tactical milestones for the projects their team supports. They advise senior management on the technical strategy for a product or a platform project. They maintain active liaison with other Systems Analysis teams, software \& hardware teams, manufacturing teams, and user facing \& clinical engineering teams, to enable cohesion of design inputs, design architecture, specifications, and verification. They are expected to hire, coach, and retain Systems Analysis talent within their group. **Roles \& Responsibilities:** * Lead a team of Systems Analysts towards successful accomplishment of product implementation with best in class solutions and architectures * Provide in\-depth analysis and characterization of electromechanical architectures during the entire design life cycle. * Facilitate mechanical, electrical, and software integration of new prototypes and new products including complete robotic systems, manipulators, instruments, accessories, and endoscopes * Analyze complex electro\-mechanical devices for dynamic safety and clinical risk * Implement safety monitoring algorithms based on sound physics and risk analysis * Participate in clinical observations and experiments to ensure that performance requirements are relevant and realistic * Adhere to, and contribute to, design control processes, including design reviews, presentations, documentation, and verification and validation testing activities * Document and pursue intellectual property * Communicate system architectural choices to the cross functional engineering team * Improve cross functional workflow and interaction through tool building and teaching others ### **Qualifications** **Skills, Experience, Education, \& Training:** * Masters in robotics related engineering field, with a minimum 6 years of experience in control of mechatronic systems, or Ph.D. with 3 years of experience in control of mechatronic systems. * Minimum 1 year of people management experience, or minimum 3 years of cross\-functional technical leadership in a Systems Analyst or equivalent role. * Familiarity with design control processes. If you are someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative work environment and who also enjoys working closely with clients in the Data Center market, this opportunity is for you! ### **Position Title** **Telecommunications BIM Designer** **Take your career to the next level by helping deliver innovative telecommunications infrastructure projects that keep people and organizations connected. In this role, you'll work with advanced design technologies, collaborate with skilled professionals, and support projects that have a tangible impact. You'll gain exposure to diverse project environments while growing your technical expertise in a collaborative and supportive team.** ### **Position Summary** As a Telecommunications BIM Designer, you'll support the design and development of telecommunications systems through Building Information Modeling (BIM) and digital design tools. You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to create accurate models and drawings that support project delivery, quality objectives, and client requirements. Develop and maintain BIM models, drawings, and design documentation for telecommunications systems across a variety of projects. Coordinate closely with engineers, designers, and other disciplines to ensure integrated and clash\-free designs. Support project teams by producing accurate deliverables that meet project schedules and quality standards. Participate in client discussions and design coordination meetings as needed. Contribute to project planning, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. Apply BIM standards, industry best practices, and technical knowledge to resolve design challenges. Assist with model management, document control, and project reporting requirements. Share knowledge with team members and support the adoption of digital design tools and workflows. Help maintain a collaborative environment focused on innovation, efficiency, and technical excellence. Here's what you'll need ### **Here’s What You’ll Need:** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering Technology, Drafting, Design, Telecommunications, or a related field * Experience working with multidisciplinary teams delivering telecommunications, infrastructure, or building projects * Proficiency with BIM and CAD software tools, such as Revit, AutoCAD, or similar platforms * Knowledge of telecommunications systems, design documentation, and BIM workflows * Strong communication, coordination, and problem\-solving skills ### **Ideally, you’ll also have:** * Professional certification related to BIM, CAD, or telecommunications design * Experience working with data centers, transportation, federal, commercial, or other complex facilities projects * Familiarity with telecommunications standards, structured cabling systems, and network infrastructure design * Experience supporting BIM coordination, clash detection, and digital project delivery processes Posted Salary Range: Minimum 86,000\.00 Posted Salary Range: Upper 125,000\.00 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision and basic life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off (allocated plans start date 17 days per calendar year), seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount as well as legally mandated benefits. The base salary range for this position is $86,000\.00 to $125,000\.00; though will be paid hourly based on hours worked. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: As a Field Engineer at Reconstruction Experts, you will play a pivotal role in leading our onsite construction operations. Your leadership ensures efficient site management, strict OSHA compliance, exceptional quality assurance, accurate billing, and effective mentorship. By leading the subcontractor partners, you drive outstanding outcomes on\-site, fostering a culture of excellence and safety. **Why Join Us?** * **Be part of our thriving future:** Join a forward\-thinking organization with a promising trajectory. * **Make a difference:** Contribute to local communities through impactful projects. * **Engage in a positive culture:** Thrive in a rewarding and collaborative team environment. * **Receive comprehensive support:** Benefit from training and guidance from experienced leaders. * **Enjoy great perks:** Gas card, phone, laptop, health insurance, 401(k), and discretionary PTO. * **Work with the best:** Join a team where our brand is defined by our people and our culture. **Company Overview:** Reconstruction Experts specializes in comprehensive reconstruction services, including environmental testing and inspections by licensed professionals. We excel in identifying potential hidden challenges and assessing the cost impact of projects. Our full\-service contractor team addresses the construction needs for both residential and commercial spaces. We offer services such as preconstruction, HOA reconstruction, construction defect repair, insurance restoration, hospitality reconstruction, remodels, and apartment reconstruction. At Reconstruction Experts, our people define our brand and culture, emphasizing respect, integrity, courtesy, and honesty. **Key Responsibilities:** * Manage daily project reports and documentation. * Conduct safety inspections, including scaffold and PPE reviews, and Controlled Zone upkeep. * Coordinate inspections and maintain up\-to\-date inspection and photo logs. * Perform QA/QC data entry and manage construction red\-lines. * Oversee site cleaning, traffic control, signage, material runs, and other site duties. * Assist in generating contracts for owners and subcontractors with guidance from the project manager and legal counsel. * Obtain necessary permits from governing authorities. * Qualify and contact subcontractors for bids; schedule and manage bid submissions. * Develop and manage project budgets, including budget adjustments, change orders, invoices, RFIs, and schedules. * Ensure quality control throughout the project. * Collaborate with project manager and superintendent to address production and quality control issues. * Interpret plans and specifications to determine construction requirements. * Document projects through site inspections, photos, meeting minutes, take\-offs, and other methods. * Assist in developing project scopes of work. * Compile cut sheets, color selections, manufacturer’s warranties, test data, shop drawings, etc. * Monitor work progress and report any issues to the project manager and superintendent. * Ensure timely and accurate completion of all reports and records. **Physical Demands:** * Ability to stand, walk, sit at a computer, and work in confined spaces. * Capability to drive, climb ladders and stairs, work at heights over 6 feet, kneel, crouch, stoop, twist, reach, push, pull, and grasp frequently. * Willingness to work over 40 hours per week as needed and ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions. **Skills and Abilities:** * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, Outlook, and project management software. * Strong interpersonal skills and commitment to customer service. * Ability to prioritize tasks, exercise independent judgment, and collaborate effectively with colleagues. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills and knowledge of construction methods and safety regulations. **Experience:** * Previous experience in the reconstruction industry is preferred but not required. **Education Requirements:** * High school diploma or equivalent. * Associate's degree in Construction Science, Construction Management, or equivalent work experience. **Apply Today!** *Join a team that values integrity and diversity and take your career to the next level with us. The successful candidate must have the right to work in the USA and be prepared for a pre\-employment criminal background check.* \#LI\-MK1

jobs.title: Principal Thermal Systems Product Engineer (onsite)
jobs.description: **About Johnson Controls** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. **What you will do** -------------------- Johnson Controls is seeking a Principal Thermal Systems Engineer to help shape the future of data center cooling technology. As a key member of our Data Center Thermal Solutions team, you will take ownership of the complete product lifecycle for next\-generation thermal systems, from early concept development and system architecture through certification, global production launch, and long\-term product sustainment. In this highly visible role, you will collaborate with global cross\-functional teams to transform customer needs and emerging technologies into innovative, certified, and manufacturable solutions. You will drive critical decisions that influence product performance, quality, cost, profitability, and market success while advancing cutting\-edge thermal solutions for one of the world's fastest\-growing industries. This position is based in New Freedom, PA, where onsite collaboration is essential to driving innovation and execution. Candidates should live within commuting distance or be open to relocation. Competitive relocation assistance packages are available. **How you will do it** ---------------------- * Plan and execute complex thermal product development projects and product releases; own full thermal system designs from concept through production launches and manage engineering changes in SAP across global factories * Serve as the primary technical interface between research/advanced development teams and design engineering, translating research findings into actionable product development plans * Work closely with the design and manufacturing teams in generating layout concepts and system configurations that consider the best balance of cost, performance, and reliability * Define specifications for complete thermal systems including multi\-domain requirements (thermal, controls, electrical) and manufacturing constraints * Own PDP deliverables (DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans) and lead validation test programs * Lead process improvement initiatives across thermal product development domains * May supervise a team of 2\-5 engineers plus technicians on thermal system product development projects * Resolve escalated production and field issues through root cause and corrective action * Secure and maintain agency approvals (UL, CE/PED, ASME, and regional standards) **What you will need** **Required** ------------ * Minimum Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or similar discipline * CAD proficiency (SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent) * Engineering calculations and documentation (MathCAD, EES, or equivalent) * 4\+ years of professional experience with heat transfer analysis (conduction, convection, two\-phase), thermodynamic cycle analysis, fluid mechanics, hydraulic system design, and thermal system component sizing and selection * 4\+ years of experience within the commercial HVAC industry; preferably chillers * 4\+ years experience with released thermal products or systems **Preferred** ------------- * Python scripting and environment management (package installation, virtual environments, basic automation) * CFD (ANSYS Fluent, Star\-CCM\+, OpenFOAM, or equivalent) * FEA (ANSYS Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent) * MATLAB/Simulink for system modeling and controls * Controls fundamentals (feedback loops, PID tuning, system response) * Electrical systems basics (motor sizing, VFDs, power distribution) * Refrigeration system design and refrigerant properties * Data center cooling architectures (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers, CDUs) HIRING SALARY RANGE: $100,000 \- $130,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance. This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about\-us \#LI\-ONSITE

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Maintenance, Reliability, & Automation
jobs.description: **Senior Manager, Maintenance, Reliability \& Automation** **Location:** Lubbock, Texas **Business:** Johnson Controls \| Fire Solutions North America **About Us** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. **Position Overview** Johnson Controls is seeking an exceptional Senior Manager, Maintenance, Reliability \& Automation to lead the transformation of our maintenance organization and serve as a key architect in the evolution of our Lubbock manufacturing facility toward an Industry 4\.0\-enabled future. This is not a traditional maintenance leadership role. The successful candidate will be responsible for building a world\-class reliability organization that moves beyond reactive maintenance and supports the deployment of advanced automation, connected manufacturing technologies, predictive maintenance systems, and future autonomous manufacturing capabilities. As a key member of the plant leadership team, this leader will partner closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, EHS, and external technology partners to develop the systems, infrastructure, talent, and reliability strategies required to support long\-term growth and manufacturing modernization. This role will play a critical leadership position in shaping the future manufacturing footprint by influencing equipment design, capital investment decisions, maintainability standards, workforce development strategies, and digital transformation initiatives. **What You Will Do** **Reliability \& Maintenance Excellence** * Develop and execute a comprehensive reliability\-centered maintenance strategy focused on improving uptime, equipment performance, and manufacturing throughput. * Transform the maintenance organization from reactive firefighting to a proactive, data\-driven reliability model. * Lead deployment and sustainability of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) across manufacturing operations. * Establish asset criticality models, reliability engineering practices, preventive maintenance programs, and predictive maintenance systems. * Implement advanced root cause problem\-solving methodologies, including RCA, 5 Why, Pareto analysis, and failure mode analysis. * Drive measurable improvements in equipment availability, MTBF, MTTR, maintenance cost, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE). **Industry 4\.0 \& Digital Manufacturing** * Lead the integration of connected factory technologies that provide real\-time equipment performance visibility and predictive maintenance capabilities. * Evaluate and deploy IIoT, machine monitoring, condition\-based monitoring, and AI\-enabled maintenance solutions. * Develop digital maintenance roadmaps that support long\-term automation objectives. * Implement systems that leverage equipment health data to improve planning, diagnostics, and resource utilization. * Serve as a champion for technology adoption and the modernization of maintenance systems. **Automation \& Capital Strategy** * Partner closely with Manufacturing Engineering to support automation initiatives and future manufacturing capabilities. * Influence equipment procurement standards with a focus on reliability, maintainability, lifecycle cost, and operational performance. * Support the development and execution of multi\-year capital investment plans. * Lead commissioning, startup, and reliability readiness activities for new equipment and automation systems. * Develop long\-term equipment lifecycle management strategies that proactively address obsolescence, capacity requirements, and operational risk. **Talent Development \& Workforce Strategy** * Build a high\-performing maintenance organization capable of supporting increasingly complex manufacturing technologies. * Develop maintenance technicians, supervisors, planners, and reliability engineers through structured coaching and succession planning. * Establish partnerships with technical colleges, trade schools, and workforce development organizations to create a sustainable pipeline of skilled trades talent. * Champion apprenticeship programs, technical certifications, and workforce development initiatives. * Build a culture of ownership, accountability, urgency, and continuous improvement. **Facilities \& Contractor Management** * Provide leadership and oversight for facilities management activities and facility infrastructure systems. * Develop a localized contractor network capable of supporting specialized maintenance and emergency response requirements. * Manage external service providers and facility support partners. * Develop outsourcing strategies that allow internal resources to remain focused on reliability\-critical activities. **Qualifications** **Require**d * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Manufacturing, Maintenance Management, or related field. * 10\+ years of progressive manufacturing maintenance leadership experience. * 5\+ years leading maintenance organizations within a complex manufacturing environment. * Demonstrated experience implementing TPM, preventive maintenance, and predictive maintenance systems. * Proven success developing maintenance teams and technical talent. * Strong experience with root cause analysis, reliability improvement, and structured problem solving. * Experience managing capital projects, budgets, and external service providers. **Preferred** * Experience in highly automated manufacturing environments. * Experience supporting robotics, PLC\-controlled systems, automated assembly, conveyors, vision systems, or advanced manufacturing technologies. * Reliability engineering certification, CMRP, CRL, or equivalent. * Experience with Industry 4\.0 technologies and connected factory systems. * Knowledge of CMMS platforms such as SAP PM, Maximo, Fiix, eMaint, or equivalent. * Experience implementing predictive analytics, condition monitoring, machine learning, or AI\-enabled maintenance solutions. * Experience supporting large\-scale manufacturing transformation initiatives. **Leadership Competencies** The successful candidate will demonstrate: * Strategic thinking balanced by operational execution. * Strong business acumen and manufacturing systems thinking. * Exceptional talent development and coaching capabilities. * Data\-driven decision making. * High levels of accountability and ownership. * Cross\-functional influence and change leadership. * Ability to lead through ambiguity and transformation. * Relentless focus on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer satisfaction. **Success in This Role** Within your first 12\-24 months, you will: * Establish a reliability\-centered maintenance culture. * Launch predictive maintenance and connected asset monitoring capabilities. * Build a sustainable skilled trades development pipeline. * Reduce unplanned downtime and improve equipment effectiveness. * Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to develop automation and equipment standards. * Create a multi\-year maintenance, reliability, and capital roadmap aligned to the facility's Industry 4\.0 strategy. * Position the Lubbock operation to support increasingly autonomous manufacturing technologies and future lights\-out manufacturing capabilities. **Why This Opportunity?** This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of one of Johnson Controls' flagship manufacturing operations. The successful candidate will help define the maintenance, reliability, automation, and workforce strategies that enable the next generation of manufacturing excellence while building an organization capable of supporting a highly automated, digitally connected factory of the future. **Hiring Salary Range** $112,100\.00 \- 187,100\.00 USD Annual (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, location and alignment with market data.) This position includes a competitive benefits package. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about\-us

jobs.title: Systems Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Krai Solutions is seeking an experienced **Senior Unified Communications Systems \& Integration Engineer** to provide specialized technical support for a Federal enterprise Audio Visual (AV), Video Teleconferencing (VTC), and Unified Communications environment. This is a part\-time, 1099 consulting position requiring up to **20 hours per month**. The engineer will serve as a senior technical resource supporting AV/UC system architecture, OEM platform integration, API integration, remote monitoring and diagnostics, complex troubleshooting, configuration management, and remote\-remediation capabilities. The engineer will work closely with Krai's platform, security, program, and operations teams and our AV field\-service partner to support a geographically distributed, multi\-vendor AV/UC environment. The role will help Krai implement a **proactive, remote\-first service assurance model** in which authorized issues are detected, diagnosed, and resolved remotely whenever practical before onsite field intervention is required. Key Responsibilities * Provide senior engineering support for enterprise **AV, VTC, and Unified Communications systems**. * Support integration and administration of OEM management platforms such as **Poly/HP Clariti, Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management, Crestron, Q\-SYS, Extron, Biamp**, and comparable AV technologies. * Evaluate OEM APIs and management interfaces for device inventory, health, telemetry, alerts, diagnostics, configuration, firmware, and remote\-management capabilities. * Work with Krai software engineers to integrate OEM platforms with the **Krai Unified Monitoring Platform**. * Develop and test lightweight API integrations, scripts, prototypes, and utilities using **Java, Python, or comparable technologies** where appropriate. * Use REST APIs and OEM interfaces to retrieve device health, inventory, alerts, configuration, and diagnostic information. * Support authorized remote\-management actions through OEM APIs, including device/service restart, reboot, peripheral reconnection, configuration validation, and restoration to approved baselines. * Diagnose complex AV/VTC incidents escalated beyond routine Tier 1 support. * Validate system health following remediation and determine when onsite intervention or OEM escalation is required. * Assist Krai developers with **API specifications, authentication requirements, payloads, error handling, API testing, and integration troubleshooting**. * Support event and telemetry normalization across multiple OEM platforms. * Develop and maintain technical runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, remediation playbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge\-base content. * Support room/device inventory validation and configuration baselining. * Conduct root\-cause analysis of recurring failures and recommend corrective or preventive actions. * Support proactive health checks, firmware management, lifecycle assessments, and preventive\-maintenance activities. * Provide technical input into monitoring thresholds, alert correlation, device\-health models, and automation rules. * Support testing and validation of new monitoring, diagnostic, integration, and remediation capabilities before production deployment. * Coordinate with Krai platform engineers, security personnel, program management, AV technicians, OEM support organizations, and Government technical personnel as required. Required Qualifications * **7\+ years of experience** supporting enterprise Unified Communications, AV/VTC, collaboration, or conferencing environments. * Strong hands\-on experience troubleshooting integrated conference\-room technologies, including codecs, displays, cameras, microphones, DSPs, control systems, and network\-connected AV equipment. * Experience with **Poly/HP video conferencing and management technologies**, preferably including Poly Clariti or related management platforms. * Working knowledge of **Microsoft Teams Rooms** and enterprise collaboration environments. * Experience with one or more major AV ecosystems such as **Crestron, Q\-SYS, Extron, Biamp, Shure, Sennheiser, or Vaddio**. * Experience with remote device monitoring, diagnostics, configuration, firmware management, and troubleshooting. * Strong understanding of **TCP/IP networking, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, HTTPS, SNMP, Syslog, certificates, and firewalls** as they relate to AV/UC systems. * Working knowledge of **Java, Python, or a comparable programming/scripting language**, sufficient to develop, test, or troubleshoot basic system integrations. * Working knowledge of **REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, OAuth 2\.0, API keys/tokens, webhooks, and service\-to\-service authentication**. * Experience using tools such as **Postman, curl, Swagger/OpenAPI**, or equivalent tools for API testing and troubleshooting. * Ability to analyze logs, alerts, API responses, device status, and configuration information to isolate complex technical problems. * Ability to independently research and interpret OEM API and integration documentation. * Strong technical documentation and communication skills. * Ability to work independently as a senior technical resource with limited supervision. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing or supporting integrations using **Java/Spring Boot and/or Python**. * Experience integrating AV/UC platforms with enterprise **monitoring, ITSM, CMDB, observability, or automation platforms**. * Familiarity with event\-driven integration technologies, webhooks, message queues, SNMP, Syslog, and event normalization. * Familiarity with **AWS and AWS GovCloud**, including secure API integration and cloud/network integration patterns. * Experience supporting AV/VTC systems within a **Federal Government environment**. * Familiarity with Federal cybersecurity requirements, least\-privilege access, change management, audit logging, configuration management, and controlled administrative access. * Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise ITSM platforms. * Relevant industry certifications such as **CTS, CTS\-I, CTS\-D, Crestron, Q\-SYS, Extron, Biamp, Poly/HP, or Microsoft Teams** are desirable. Applicant Notice **Please apply only if you meet the required qualifications outlined in this job description.** This is a specialized senior\-level position requiring demonstrated experience in Unified Communications/AV\-VTC systems, OEM management platforms, networking, API integration, and remote diagnostics. Candidates whose experience does not substantially align with these requirements may not be considered. Pay: $66\.40 \- $69\.74 per hour Expected hours: No more than 20\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * Poly/HP video conferencing and management technologies: 5 years (Required) * TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, HTTPS, SNMP, Syslog, firewalls: 5 years (Required) * REST, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, OAuth 2\.0, API keys/tokens, webhooks: 5 years (Required) * Java, Python, or a comparable programming/scripting language: 5 years (Required) Location: * Washington, DC 20001 (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Washington, DC 20001 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20001

jobs.title: Fractional Product Manager, Renewable Energy (LG NOVA)
jobs.description: Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations. Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions. Our management philosophy, "Jeong\-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer\-Value Creation' and 'People\-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone. **Fractional Product Manager, Renewable Energy** **Location:** Remote / Hybrid **Engagement:** Fractional contract, approximately 15–20 hours/week **LG Electronics North America Innovation Center (“LG NOVA”)** LG Electronics established North America Innovation Center (“LG NOVA”) in Santa Clara, California, USA., in the heart of Silicon Valley, with an ambitious vision to become the nerve center of global innovation. Aiming to create the future of LG with the focus on disruptive and exponential growth, LG NOVA works with global corporations, startups, governments, and technology stakeholders to create new businesses, establish strategic partnerships, and develop a broad ecosystem using the process of “outside\-in” innovation. **About Us** ============ LG Nova is building an AI\-powered Intelligence Layer and Development Orchestration Platform for utility\-scale renewable energy development. The platform brings together project data, documents, workflows, engineering information, permitting, interconnection, financial analysis, and AI\-powered intelligence to help renewable energy developers move projects from initial opportunity through development and ultimately to market—faster and with greater visibility and control. We are transitioning from proof\-of\-concept into commercialization and are looking for an experienced Fractional Product Manager to help turn customer requirements, domain expertise, and our technology vision into a focused, executable product roadmap. **The Opportunity** =================== This is a highly hands\-on role for an **experienced product leader** (part\-time/contract), from the **renewable energy industry,** who can operate comfortably in an early\-stage environment. You will work closely with the founders, engineering team, renewable energy development experts, customers, and advisors to define what we build, why we build it, and in what order. This is not a maintenance product\-management role. We are looking for an experienced product leader who wants to help define an entirely new category of AI\-powered software for renewable energy development. The ideal candidate understands that early\-stage product management isn't about writing requirements and handing them to engineering. It's about understanding the renewable energy developer customer deeply, identifying the highest\-value problems, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working with engineering to rapidly deliver products that customers will actually use and pay for. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Product Strategy \& Roadmap** ------------------------------- * Own and continuously refine the product roadmap. * Translate the company's vision and customer feedback into clear product priorities. * Define MVPs and prioritize features based on customer value, strategic importance, technical feasibility, and time to market. * Establish a disciplined product\-development process as the company moves from POC to commercial product. * Maintain a clear distinction between must\-have capabilities, near\-term enhancements, and future opportunities. **Customer Discovery \& Product\-Market Fit** --------------------------------------------- * Work directly with renewable energy developers to understand their workflows, pain points, and technology needs. * Participate in customer interviews, POC demos, and product feedback sessions. * Convert customer feedback into actionable product requirements rather than simply collecting feature requests. * Identify opportunities where AI can fundamentally improve the way renewable energy development is performed. * Help establish measurable product\-market\-fit indicators and customer success criteria. **AI Product Development** -------------------------- * Work closely with the engineering and AI teams to identify where AI can provide differentiated value. * Help define AI\-powered workflows, agents, predictions, recommendations, and automation. * Ensure AI capabilities uirement that evening, and make a difficult prioritization decision the next morning. * Customer obsessed * Technically curious * Highly analytical * Comfortable with AI * An excellent communicator * A strong prioritizer * Entrepreneurial * Low ego / high ownership * Comfortable saying “no” * Excited by ambiguous problems * Able to move quickly without sacrificing product quality **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Establish a clear and prioritized 12–18 month product roadmap. * Convert POC/customer feedback into a commercially viable product. * Establish a repeatable product discovery and development process. * Define clear MVP requirements and acceptance criteria. * Prioritize the highest\-value AI capabilities. * Improve alignment between customers, product, engineering, and sales. * Create a product roadmap that supports the company's transition from POC to paying customers. **Compensation** ================ * This position is fully remote within the United States. * This is a contract fractional engagement of approximately 15–20 hours per week. * The anticipated pay range for this contract position is **$100\-$135 per hour**, depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and market considerations. **Additional Information:** =========================== * This position is fully remote within the United States. * This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. jobs.title: Sr Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **The group you’ll be a part of** --------------------------------- In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting\-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. **The impact you’ll make** -------------------------- As a Systems Engineer 4 at Lam, you will lead system definition and cross\-functional integration for complex semiconductor equipment, including processing modules, and cluster tool architectures. You will serve as a key technical interface between process engineering and multidisciplinary development teams, helping translate product vision into clear requirements, robust architectures, and executable verification strategies. This role requires strong systems thinking, independent technical judgment, and the ability to drive alignment from concept through release. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Serve as a primary systems engineering point of contact between process engineering and cross\-functional teams, including mechanical, electrical, controls, reliability, manufacturing, facilities, and software engineering. * Lead technical scoping and systems engineering planning for new products, technology changes, and subsystem enhancements, including drafting and maintaining a Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP), defining work products, technical reviews, traceability, and verification approach. * Translate customer, product, process, safety, and business needs into clear system, controls, and software requirements and functional specifications using INCOSE\-aligned systems engineering practices. * Develop and maintain system architecture, theory of operation, functional breakdowns, interface definitions, and architecture options for process modules and cluster tools. * Drive architecture trade studies, gap and risk analysis, and closure planning to support sound technical decisions and design maturity. * Generate and coordinate key systems engineering work products, including system documents, P\&IDs, device lists, interconnects, signal lists, SW functional specifications and other interface and integration artifacts. * Support cluster tool design through system\-level analysis such as wafer flow and throughput modeling, productivity analysis, and facilities definition. * Lead or coordinate safety and reliability activities, including hazard analysis, interlock definition, and FMEA. * Define test, verification, and validation plans and work across process, hardware, controls, and software teams to ensure requirements are fully verified and validated. * Apply sound engineering judgment to improve systems engineering methods, documentation quality, and development workflows, including responsible adoption of AI\-enabled tools to enhance analysis, knowledge access, and productivity. * Use modern engineering tools and AI\-assisted workflows, including Python, VS Code, GitHub Copilot, foundation models, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, with strong human oversight and accountability. **Who we’re looking for** ------------------------- * Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related technical field. * Proven ability to work across disciplines and integrate inputs from process, mechanical, electrical, controls, manufacturing, facilities, and software teams in the development of complex systems. * Demonstrated ability to draft and maintain a Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP) and use it to guide systems engineering work products, technical reviews, traceability, and verification planning. * Strong systems thinking and technical leadership skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous needs into structured requirements, interfaces, architecture decisions, and executable work products. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment and communicate technical content clearly across functions. * Proficiency with standard engineering productivity tools and the ability to produce clear, structured technical documentation in English. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with semiconductor capital equipment, process modules, vacuum systems, gas delivery, thermal systems, thin film deposition, or related technologies. * Experience developing systems engineering artifacts such as requirements, P\&IDs, device lists, interconnects, signal lists, interface documents, hazard analyses, interlock definitions, and FMEA. * Working knowledge of INCOSE systems engineering practices and familiarity with ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 and ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 for lifecycle and requirements engineering. * Experience with architecture trade studies, wafer flow and throughput analysis, productivity analysis, facilities definition, and reliability methods. * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern engineering development environments such as VS Code. * Experience with AI\-assisted engineering workflows, including GitHub Copilot, foundation LLM models, and retrieval\- or agent\-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and technical quality. * Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to build reusable skills, assistants, or agents that augment systems engineering work under strong human oversight. **Our commitment** ------------------ We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non\-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. *Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on\-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On\-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On\-site Flex’ you’ll work 3\+ days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1\-2 days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.* \#LI\-CW1 **Our Perks and Benefits** At Lam, our people make amazing things possible. This is not a research or advisory role — you move from discovery to working prototype to deployed solution within sprint cycles, in close partnership with a Domain Leader who provides business direction and context. The right candidate is energized by driving meaningful change in a business — not just shipping code but making sure what gets built is genuinely adopted and used. You are comfortable working with typical tech stacks such as Microsoft and ServiceNow as well as building custom AI agents/ solutions on other internal platforms. **What You Will Do** **Discover and Define** * Embed in a business function and work with the Domain Leader and subject matter experts to map workflows, surface pain points, and identify high\-value AI opportunities. * Translate business problems into scoped, deliverable use cases — balancing ambition with what is practical to build and adopt. **Build and Deploy** * Design and build AI solutions using the right tools for the problem: Microsoft AI and productivity platforms (Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, M365\), RAG pipelines, agent workflows, automation tooling, and custom development where needed. * Prototype quickly, test with real users, and iterate within short sprint cycles. * Deliver solutions that integrate into existing workflows — not standalone demos. **Drive Adoption and Impact** * Own adoption as well as technical delivery — work alongside change resources to help teams actually use what gets built. * Gather feedback post\-deployment to improve performance and increase business value over time. * Contribute to patterns and practices that can scale across squads and functions. **Communicate and Collaborate** * Bridge business stakeholders, data teams, and platform partners — translating clearly in both directions. * Provide concise, honest updates on progress, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and senior non\-technical audiences alike. **What We’re Looking For** **Required** * 5\+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI, or a closely related technical role. * Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI, automation, or intelligent workflow solutions in real business settings. * Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt design, retrieval\-based architectures, orchestration, and agent\-based systems. * Comfortable integrating with enterprise APIs, data sources, and workflow platforms. * A genuine drive to see change land — you understand that building the solution is only half the job. * Clear communicator; able to explain technical decisions in plain language to business and leadership audiences. **Preferred** * Experience with Microsoft AI platforms: Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, M365, Power Platform. * Custom development skills (Python, JavaScript, or similar) for problems that off\-the\-shelf tooling cannot solve. * Background in technical consulting, solutions architecture, or customer\-facing engineering. * Experience with change enablement, user adoption, or process redesign alongside technical delivery. **What Success Looks Like** * Working solutions in users’ hands at the end of each sprint — not decks or proofs of concept. * Measurable business outcomes: time saved, processes improved, decisions made faster. * A team that has adopted the tools and can articulate the impact. * A function that can operate and evolve its AI solutions after the engagement ends. We offer flexibility in where you work! This role is eligible for remote work. If you live within commuting distance of our Chicago, IL or Raleigh, NC offices, you'll enjoy a hybrid schedule with three days in the office and two days working from home each week. If you're located outside of these areas, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely, based on business needs. *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.* **Additional Locations**: * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville * United States of America * United States of America \- North Carolina * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville **PAY TRANSPARENCY** The anticipated annual compensation range for this position is **152,000–233,105** **USD**. jobs.title: Network Engineer I
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Network Engineer supports Liberty Alliance's Technology Division by configuring, maintaining, securing, and troubleshooting network systems critical to corporate infrastructure and event operations. The role is responsible for the deployment, configuration, monitoring, and security of UniFi and Cisco network infrastructure, including switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VLANs, VPN configurations, Starlink systems, and supporting network services. The Network Engineer contributes to network performance, availability, security, and reliability through proactive monitoring, configuration management, firmware management, vulnerability remediation, documentation, and event support. The position also supports Liberty Alliance's cybersecurity and compliance requirements, including NIST SP 800\-171 and CMMC, by implementing, maintaining, documenting, and providing evidence for applicable network security controls. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **POSITION REQUIREMENTS AND ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** ===================================================== **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ * Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot UniFi and Cisco networking devices, including gateways/firewalls, switches, wireless access points, and network controllers. * Configure and maintain VLANs, SSIDs, routing, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, firewall policies, access control lists (ACLs), and network segmentation. * Maintain appropriate separation between corporate, guest, AV/IoT, management, event, and other network environments based on organizational security requirements. * Monitor wired and wireless network infrastructure for outages, performance degradation, security events, and anomalous activity. * Perform troubleshooting for wired and wireless connectivity issues and resolve Level 1 and Level 2 network tickets within assigned scope. * Support VPN and secure remote\-access configurations as required. * Assist with installation of cabling, racks, patch panels, fiber, PoE infrastructure, and other physical network infrastructure. * Perform firmware updates, security patches, and vulnerability remediation for network appliances. * Maintain secure configurations and approved configuration baselines for network infrastructure. * Review network\-device configurations and identify unnecessary or insecure ports, protocols, services, firewall rules, and administrative interfaces. * Configure, maintain, review, and document firewall rules, network segmentation, VLANs, ACLs, VPNs, and other network security controls in accordance with approved security policies and change\-management procedures. * Maintain network logging and support centralized collection and review of security\-relevant logs from firewalls, gateways, switches, wireless infrastructure, and other applicable devices. * Support vulnerability scanning, remediation, and validation activities involving network infrastructure. * Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, data flows, configuration records, and inventories of network assets. * Support installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of Starlink and other temporary or event network infrastructure. * Collaborate with IT, cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and other Technology Division personnel on site setup, events, special projects, and security requirements. * Complete all other tasks and duties as needed to help drive Liberty Alliance's Vision, fulfill our Mission, and abide by the organization's values. **QUALIFICATIONS** ================== **Required** ------------ * High school diploma/GED required; associate degree, technical training, or equivalent experience in networking, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field preferred. * 5\+ years of relevant experience in network operations or IT infrastructure. * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, and wireless networking. * Experience configuring and troubleshooting firewalls, switches, wireless access points, and VPNs. * Familiarity with Cisco and/or UniFi/Ubiquiti networking equipment. * Understanding of network security concepts including segmentation, ACLs, firewall policies, least privilege, secure remote access, logging, and network monitoring. * Working knowledge of NIST SP 800\-171 and CMMC requirements as they apply to network infrastructure. * Ability to implement technical network security controls based on organizational cybersecurity and compliance requirements. * Ability to maintain accurate network diagrams, configuration documentation, inventories, change records, and other technical evidence. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work with cybersecurity and compliance personnel to remediate findings and maintain secure, compliant configurations. * Ability to follow directions, document work, and adapt in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred** ------------- * Hands\-on experience with UniFi gateways/controllers, VLANs, SSIDs, firewall policies, VPNs, PoE switches, and wireless access points. * Experience supporting a CMMC, NIST SP 800\-171, DoD, Defense Industrial Base (DIB), or other regulated environment. * Experience implementing network segmentation for CUI or other sensitive environments. * Experience supporting SSP documentation, POA\&M remediation, cybersecurity assessments, or audit evidence collection. * Experience hardening network devices using approved configuration or security baselines. * Experience reviewing firewall rules, ACLs, network services, and administrative access. * Familiarity with secure wireless network design and enterprise authentication. * Experience with Starlink systems, temporary/field networking, and event network deployments. * Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing and change\-management systems. * Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA Network\+, Cisco CCT/CCNA, or Ubiquiti certifications. **WORKING CONDITIONS** ====================== Work is performed in office, and field environments, with a mix of indoor and outdoor exposure. Must be able to walk, stand, and sit for extended periods, and occasionally climb or work in crawlspaces, ceilings, or racks. Requires the ability to lift up to 50 pounds and safely handle networking equipment and cabling. Work may involve moderate noise levels and occasional heat exposure. **TO APPLY** ============ Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your qualifications and experience. Only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT** ========================================== Liberty Alliance is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Liberty Alliance is committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment and where employees are treated with respect and dignity.

jobs.title: Account Executive – Outbound
jobs.description: ### **About Lucid Bots** Lucid Bots is a U.S. AI robotics manufacturer building exterior cleaning drones and robotics for commercial and government customers. Since 2018, our fleet of 500\+ robots has helped operators generate over $75M in revenue by taking on dull, dirty, and dangerous work — safely and efficiently. Our mission: extend human reach. We're based in Charlotte, NC, where we design, engineer, manufacture, and support our products in the U.S. Customers worldwide — from global enterprises to owner\-operators — deploy our robots to improve safety and productivity. We're one of the fastest\-growing U.S. manufacturers (recently ranked \#4 nationally), backed by a $20M Series B and investors including Y Combinator (S19\). We're building more than robots—we're building the future of physical AI. ### **Our Core Values and How We Work Together** At Lucid Bots, we're building something extraordinary \- and how we work matters just as much as what we build. These values guide how we hire, grow, and show up for one another. * **Expedition Behavior** \- We climb as one. No silos, no "that's not my job." We protect the team and share the load. * **Grow with Humility** \- We're relentless learners. We seek feedback, own mistakes, and get better every day. * **Lift People Up** \- Humans come first. We care fiercely, speak honestly, and design for real people in real conditions. * **Build the Extraordinary** \- We take ownership, reject the ordinary, and run toward hard problems. We live *Above the Line*: we take responsibility, create solutions, and shape the future. If these values energize you, you'll thrive here. If they feel like too much, this may not be the right climb \- and that's okay. ### **About This Role** In this role, you'll build pipeline from scratch and close it. You hunt, earn the conversation, and own deals end to end — measured on closed\-won, not busywork. You'll execute Lucid's outbound motion: convert meetings into real pipeline early, then own a revenue target. Built for people who like hunting and scaling what works. ### **What You'll Do** * Prospect and qualify through outbound (cold outreach, LinkedIn/social, referrals, events, targeted accounts) * Own the full cycle from first touch through negotiation and close * Test messaging and ICP targeting; share what works so the playbook gets sharper * Keep CRM tight — hygiene, forecasting, and deal progression Get curious about the product and what actually moves our buyers * ### **Who You Are** * 2–4 years B2B sales with a track record of self\-generating pipeline (not just riding inbound) * You've hit or exceeded quota consistently in a role where outbound was primary or required * You qualify fast, push deals forward, and walk away from noise * Comfortable with ambiguity — you don't need a finished playbook to start Hardware, SaaS, industrial, or field\-ops background is a plus * ### **Why Join Lucid Bots?** * Work directly with the founder of a fast\-growing, venture\-backed robotics startup. * Be part of a team solving real\-world problems with frontier technology. * Get a front\-row seat to fundraising, company building, and startup strategy at scale. * Learn more in one year than most people do in five—this is a career accelerant. Help support the culture, pace, and systems of a company scaling fast and building things that matter. * ### **Benefits:** * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 3% retirement match * 15 days of paid time off (PTO) * 3 sick days * 11 paid holidays, with 3 of those being floating holidays Employee stock option plan * ### **Additional Notes** This role is based in Charlotte, NC. Hybrid flexibility is possible, but significant on\-site presence is expected. ### **We'd Love to Hear from You!** Don't just apply. Stand out. **The Reality:** On paper, many resumes look the same. We don't hire paper; we hire people. While a video is technically optional, it is the single best way to separate yourself from the stack. **The Promise:** This is not a black hole. If you take the time to record it, we will take the time to watch it. **What to Send:** (2 mins max) Please do not read a script. Do not worry about editing or production value. Just open your camera and talk to us. * **Why here?** Why are you excited about Lucid Bots specifically? * **Why you?** What is the one thing about you that a resume can't capture? If you want the highest probability of an interview, send us a video.

jobs.title: Space RCO Program Management & Acquisition Support/Warfighter Integration (Senior)
jobs.description: MTSI is searching for a senior Program Management and Acquisition Support (PM\&AS) professional to support development of first\-of\-kind space vehicles and missions. This handpicked candidate must possess technical expertise and experience with developing, designing, building, and integrating space hardware and software. In this position, you will provide System Engineering Technical Assistance (SETA) to the Space Rapid Capabilities Office (RCO), specifically to the Warfighter Integration Branch. The Space RCO program office, located at Kirtland AFB, NM, is a small, streamlined organization with dedicated, organic acquisition support functions: contracting, financial management, human resources, security, program management and technical engineering support that are critical in enabling the rapid response required for classified space programs. The mission is to develop and deliver operationally dominant space capabilities at the speed of warfighting relevance in response to Commander, U.S. Space Command requirements. A successful candidate should be a leader and problem solver with a proven ability to deliver superior results as part of a high performing team in a high\-profile, fast\-paced environment. **PM\&AS Principal Duty**You will work in a small, highly empowered team where every team member is directly responsible for the success of the program. Engineering responsibilities span technology domains including space rated hardware, software, sensors, and processors in an extremely fast\-paced, responsive development environment. This SETA candidate will provide in\-depth background on satellite vehicle bus and/or subsystems to improve program office insight into state\-of\-the art commercial and legacy mission systems, and C2 requirements and capabilities. You must apply advanced principles, theories, and concepts for highly classified systems, while also effectively communicating complex results with management and executive leadership.**SETA Role and Responsibilities:*** Serves as program advisory lead for extremely time critical technical projects, test projects, or tasks requiring appropriate level technical expertise * Leverages operations experience to assist SpRCO program offices in developing and fielding space systems * Assists acquisition planning, market research, and drafting technical requirements and documents * Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to verify program needs and identified to meet project goals * Helps the government assess the technical sufficiency, cost, quality, and timely delivery of program deliverables * Confers with engineers to provide technical advice and to assist with problem resolution as needed * Supports management and execution of programs consisting of multiple projects\-ensures overall program is properly coordinated and efficiently accomplished with the best available resources * Aids in the development of a Monthly Status Report on all support efforts including updates in status and performance, major activities, challenges and opportunities, deliverables, and subcontractor performance * Drafts, reviews, and edits final program reports, documents, and briefings * Supports acquisition planning and development of documents required for systems acquisition. * Coordinates with external agencies to include operational units, higher headquarters,
