jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 25,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers are amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility. Our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to make an impact. And if that's you we would love to have you join us! Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments. **Position Summary:** The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high\-quality customer experience. **Responsibilities:** * Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features. * Validate design\-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience. * Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team. * Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details. * Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria. * Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities. * Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices. * Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking. * Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time. * Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience. * Legal authorization to work in the US is required. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 4 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role. * Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases. * Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C\#, or similar programming or scripting languages. * Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks * Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions * Familiarity with Linux * Experience with C\# scripting * Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest. * Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing. * Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP\-CUA **What We Offer:** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life. * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com . *At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.* This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-LifeAtRok \#LI\-SB1 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at \+1 (844\) 404\-7247\. Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, LTV
jobs.description: Root was founded on the belief that car insurance is broken, and we set out to change it. We’re harnessing the power of technology to revolutionize this archaic, complicated industry. Using machine learning and mobile telematic platforms, we’ve built one of the most innovative insurtech companies in the world. **The Opportunity** We believe that a disruptive insurance company must have a principled quantitative framework at its foundation. At Root, we are committed to the rigorous development and effective deployment of modern statistical machine learning methods to problems in the insurance industry. Root is seeking a Staff Data Scientist I to lead the design, development, and oversight of the models that power our customer lifetime value ecosystem. This ecosystem includes hundreds of interdependent models and workflows covering conversion, retention, future premium, and claim losses. Its complexity and business importance require a deeply experienced data scientist who can guide and contribute to the team’s most challenging technical work while partnering directly with machine learning engineers on production deployment. new evidence emerges. * Analyze interactions among component models, diagnose underperformance, and prioritize enhancements based on their potential business value. * Design and validate experiments and measurement frameworks with clear success criteria, and assess model performance and business impact after launch. * Partner with the team manager on quarterly planning and sequencing, considering capacity, milestones, and dependencies while communicating risks and helping remove blockers. * Work with machine learning engineers and technology teams to support the production deployment of models, simulations, and forecasting workflows while balancing rigor, reliability, interpretability, and delivery speed. * Communicate recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical partners, business leaders, and senior decision\-makers. * Guide and coach other data scientists, strengthening their analytical skills, technical judgment, and subject\-matter expertise through constructive feedback. * Strengthen an inclusive, collaborative team culture and develop reusable methods, tools, and standards that improve data science work across the Lifetime Value team and influence related work across Quantitative Science. **What You Will Need to Succeed** * BS, MS, or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 8\+ years of experience delivering complex, high\-impact data science work, including predictive modeling, experimentation, and business decision support. * Strong survival analysis expertise (time\-to\-event modeling, censoring), grounded in statistical modeling, forecasting, experimental design and validation. * Software engineering skill in Python: you write modular, tested, well\-typed, readable code, and you've maintained and refactored a large shared codebase over time. * Experience building and running systems of interacting models, such as ensembles or chained predictions, with attention to both computational efficiency and clarity. * Deep expertise in Python and SQL, with extensive hands\-on experience using modern modeling and experimentation frameworks. * Strong command of foundational data science principles, including statistical methods, predictive modeling algorithms, survival analysis, time\-series forecasting, experimental design, measurement, and validation. * Demonstrated ability to frame ambiguous modeling problems, evaluate technical tradeoffs, prioritize high\-value opportunities, and deliver high\-quality results. * Experience developing and maintaining interconnected production models using MLOps practices such as feature stores, training and inference pipelines, workflow orchestration, version control, and post\-deployment monitoring. * Ability to estimate the potential value of modeling initiatives and evaluate model performance and business impact after deployment. * Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to connect technical work to business goals and explain modeling decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to varied audiences. * A track record of influencing priorities and technical direction across related workstreams while remaining accountable for hands\-on delivery. * Demonstrated ability to guide technical work, coach data scientists, and establish reusable modeling, experimentation, validation, or reporting practices that improve quality and decision\-making across related workstreams. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with customer lifetime value forecasting, simulation workflows, forecast\-versus\-actual analysis, or causal inference. * Experience with insurance or regulated financial products. * Experience with cloud\-based data and machine learning platforms and tools such as AWS, Docker, dbt, Airflow, Metaflow, Step Functions, or MLflow. * Experience building visualizations, dashboards, or reporting that help technical, business, and senior audiences understand model jobs.title: Growth Recruiter
jobs.description: **About Rox** ------------- Rox is an AI\-native B2B revenue intelligence company. We are a Series A startup under active construction. Seven months ago we were just under 60 people. Today we are closing in on 130\. We move fast, we ship constantly, and we build with the same AI\-native systems we sell to our customers. **About the Team** ------------------ Talent at Rox has been a team of one. That is about to change. We are hiring another full\-time member of the Talent team to lead Growth recruiting. This is not a sourcer\-only role. This is a full\-cycle Growth recruiter seat for someone who wants to run a desk alongside our Head of Talent — sourcing, interviewing, agencies, and candidate experience — without needing to own the function yet. **Location:** This role is based in our San Francisco office. You need to be in the office a minimum of three days a week. **Why This Role Is Growth\-Specific** ------------------------------------- At Rox, Growth means post\-sales. The roles you will recruit for sit after the deal closes and keep customers expanding with us: Growth Strategists, Forward Deployed Engineers, Data Science, InfoSec, and Customer Support. We want someone who already speaks that language walking in the door, not someone learning it on the job. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Run full\-cycle recruiting across Growth / post\-sales roles: Growth Strategists, Forward Deployed Engineers, Data Science, InfoSec, and Customer Support * Build and maintain sourcing pipelines using AI\-native tooling, not just job boards and cold outreach * Run structured interviews and contribute to hiring bar calibration * Manage agency and partner relationships end to end * Build and ship internal recruiting tools and automations (Claude, Ashby, Slack, Notion) * Keep reporting and pipeline visibility sharp for Growth hiring teams and leadership * Represent Rox at events, on calls, and in every candidate touchpoint as a face of the company * Get hands\-on with the Rox product itself, including regular dogfooding, so you can sell the mission with real conviction **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * Required: 1\+ year of professional experience, including 1\+ year of recruiting for post\-sales / Growth functions in an early\-stage startup. You have hired Growth Strategists, FDEs, Data Science, InfoSec, Customer Support, and/or adjacent customer\-facing talent — not adjacent general talent acquisition only. * Plus: Recruiting experience in an AI\-native or hyperscale SaaS environment. Scale, volume, and bar management are a plus on top of the early\-stage Growth requirement above. * **Growth fluency, not general recruiting fluency.** You know post\-sales org structures, the functions above, and the brands worth pulling from. That knowledge compounds into speed here. * **Operator or player first.** You do not wait for a lane to be defined, you build it. You have carried a desk, a number, or a pipeline yourself, not just watched one from a distance. * **High\-impact outlier.** You look for leverage everywhere and you are not precious about title or scope. * **Amazing human above all.** Rox is a small team doing a lot, and how you treat people matters as much as what you ship. * Comfort across the full stack of modern recruiting tools: Ashby, Slack, Notion, and AI\-native workflows built in Claude. * A track record of ownership, speed, craftsmanship, and learning velocity, the same bar we hold every candidate to at Rox. * **Real pull toward Rox specifically.** Between two similarly qualified candidates, the one who wants to be here, who has done the homework on the product and the mission, wins. Passion for what we're building is a genuine tiebreaker in this process. **Our Stack** ------------- Ashby, Slack, Notion, and a unique set of proprietary ai\-native tools. (shhh) **Compensation** ---------------- Base salary range: **$180,000 – $250,000 USD**. Total compensation includes benefits, stock options, and perks. **A Note on How We Hire** ------------------------- At Rox, we evaluate for ownership, client obsession, craftsmanship, speed, pivot ability, collaboration, cross\-functional impact, systems thinking, and learning velocity. We expect this role, more than any other, to embody that bar. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: VP, Security
jobs.description: **ABOUT STORD** =============== **Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This is a build role, not a maintain role. You'll inherit a real foundation — SOC 2 Type II attestation across our core platforms, a public Trust Center, EU\-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certification, and a small, capable team — and you'll own what comes next: the strategy, the team, the technical stack, and the operating rhythm that carry Stord through international expansion, continued M\&A, AI deployment across the product, and eventual public\-market scrutiny. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Strategy and governance.** ### **Set the security strategy and the multi\-year roadmap. Run our program against NIST CSF 2\.0 and expand audit scopes and certifications. Establish AI governance across our models, agents, and Stord Labs work.** **Security operations.** ### **Stand up 24/7 detection and response, initially through an MDR partnership, and progressively bring detection engineering in\-house. Own incident response end to end — playbooks, on\-call, tabletop exercises with the executive team, and the postmortems that actually change something.** **Security engineering.** ### **Build and operate the technical stack: SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud security posture management, API security, secrets management, and vulnerability management. Harden CI/CD across a 200\+ person engineering organization — signed commits, SBOM generation, dependency and secrets scanning, SAST/DAST in the pipeline.** **M\&A security integration.** ### **Stord acquires companies, and every deal brings inherited systems, credentials, and technical debt. You'll own security diligence on future targets and the integration playbook that gets acquired environments to our standard on a predictable timeline.** **Product and customer trust.** ### **Partner with Product and Engineering on secure\-by\-default design across Logistics, Brands, and Commerce. Own penetration testing and our bug bounty program. Be the executive voice in enterprise security reviews and questionnaires — the ones that decide whether a deal closes this quarter or next.** **Resilience.** ### **Own business continuity and disaster recovery for an operation where downtime means orders don't ship. Prove recovery works by testing it, not by documenting it.** **Team.** ### **Lead and grow a team spanning GRC, security operations, security engineering, application security, and cloud/infrastructure security, plus an MDR partner. You'll inherit the existing team, then define and hire the rest of the structure yourself.** **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * ### **12\+ years in security, including 5\+ leading a security function at a SaaS or platform company.** * ### **Depth in cloud\-native security at scale — AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD, API security. You should be able to hold your own in an architecture review, not just read the summary.** * ### **Hands\-on experience owning M\&A security diligence and integration.** * ### **Track record building a security program against NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 — and passing the audits.** * ### **Experience standing up or running 24/7 detection and response, whether in\-house, through MDR, or a hybrid.** * ### **Executive and Board communication chops. You can explain residual risk to a board, a trade\-off to a CFO, and a control to an engineer, and be understood by all three.** * ### **Judgment about where to spend. You know which risks justify a control, which justify a conversation, and which justify neither.** **Bonus Points** ---------------- * ### **You've taken a company through IPO readiness, or operated in a public company — SEC cybersecurity disclosure, SOX IT controls, Board reporting cadence.** * ### **You've secured operational or physical environments — warehouses, manufacturing, robotics, OT/IoT — not just cloud.** * ### **You've built AI/ML security governance for production systems, ideally against NIST AI RMF.** * ### **EU/UK regulatory experience: GDPR, DPF, NIS2, the EU AI Act.** * ### **You've worked somewhere the physical world breaks when software fails.**

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, AI & Intelligence Platform
jobs.description: **CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES OR CANADA** **About SafelyYou** SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person\-centered care across senior living through world\-leading AI, industry\-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities. Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals. SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019\), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation. **Your Role at SafelyYou** SafelyYou's AI\+Human\-In\_Loop solutions (fall detection, mobility, severity tagging, presence, and change detection) powers every product we sell. You own the AI capability roadmap as a platform: the reusable models and signals our customer\-facing teams turn into outcomes, and the path by which research becomes production value. You'll ship existing models into production in short cycles, help place a few longer research bets, and keep SafelyYou ahead as AI techniques change fast. AI research leadership sets research direction and customer\-facing PMs own customer outcomes; you own what the AI can do, how well, and at what cost. **Key Responsibilities:** **The Numbers You'll Own** * **Readiness.** Every model release passes an AI\-readiness gate (accuracy, false alarms, review cost, rollback) within the next year. * **Quality and cost.** A measurable reduction in with no loss in detection. * **Leverage.** At least one capability reused by two or more product teams, and one research bet taken to a clear continue\-or\-stop decision. **What You'll Own** * **One capability roadmap** across edge and cloud, ranked by cross\-team leverage. * **How AI is consumed:** outputs, confidence thresholds, and latency and accuracy expectations. * **Model readiness and field performance:** criteria from research to shadow deployment to production, then precision, recall, and drift in live communities. * **Human review economics:** a feedback loop with our clinical reviewers that improves models and reduces review per event. * **Research to value:** early\-learning milestones for 6–12 month bets, plus data priorities (curation, edge cases, labeling). * **Emerging AI:** track how newer techniques (vision\-language and multimodal models, agentic systems, efficient on\-device models) change what's possible, and turn the right ones into SafelyYou capabilities, such as richer event understanding and less human review. * **New sensing modalities** with Hardware \& Sensing: you own what models can extract; they own modality selection and cost. **The Ideal Candidate:** * **The hard requirement:** 7\+ years of product management, including 3\+ years leading ML or computer vision products you've taken to production and operated at scale. * Fluency in modern AI/ML (computer vision, multimodal and vision\-language models, evaluation), credible with researchers and ML engineers. Engineers who moved into product are welcome. * Well versed in how newer AI techniques have emerged, from foundation and vision\-language models to agentic systems and efficient on\-device models, with a clear point of view on where they apply in care settings and where they don't. * Experience deploying models under real\-world constraints, such as on\-device compute and latency versus accuracy. * Evidence\-driven: you design evaluations, run shadow deployments, and balance open\-ended research with commercial commitments. * **Strongly preferred:** human\-in\-the\-loop systems, non\-optical sensing, or safety\-critical AI in healthcare. **Salary Range:** *$220,000 \- $240,000 USD / $200,000 \- $220,000 CAD commensurate with experience* **Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!** SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to: * A mission\-driven company culture * Fully remote * Competitive salary \& benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision * 401k Program * Monthly Education, Well\-being \& WFH stipends * Non\-accrual PTO * Growth Potential * Company Retreats * Medical \& Family/Parental Leave At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Samsara is building a brand\-new role at the intersection of security engineering and applied AI. This person will be the most AI\-forward technologist on our Application Security team — using frontier AI models to both strengthen our security posture and stress\-test it. You'll spend one day using AI to red\-team our cloud environment and the next validating firmware vulnerabilities on our hardware, with the goal to secure our applications for AI Adversaries. This is a highly visible, org\-wide role reporting into a newly formed function, with a clear path to shape Samsara's AI security strategy for years to come. **This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.** **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. #### **In this role, you will:** * Deliver accurate, consistent security assessments of Samsara's software, code, and firmware, evaluating their resilience against AI\-driven/adversarial attacks, and implementing fixes. * Create and translate general AI security findings into Samsara\-specific fixes for our application security layer— including adapting techniques built for software to apply to hardware and embedded firmware. * Build and pressure\-test novel AI\-enabled security tooling and workflows, then drive adoption of what proves valuable across the broader security org. * Partner cross\-functionally with engineering, hardware, and leadership (including VP\-level threat modeling sessions) as Samsara's go\-to expert on AI\-related security risk. * Help define \& drive Samsara's medium\- and long\-term strategy for adopting AI safely and effectively within security operations. * Use frontier AI/LLM tools (e.g., Anthropic's and OpenAI's cybersecurity\-specific programs) hands\-on for both offensive validation (red\-teaming our own systems) and defensive tooling — required experience integrating, securing, or red\-teaming AI\-enabled systems (e.g., LLMs, agentic workflows, prompt injection/adversarial testing) is essential to this role. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years of experience in application security, vulnerability management, threat modeling, offensive security, or a closely related discipline, with demonstrated application fix impact and influence across a large part of an organization. * Hands\-on experience applying AI/LLM tools to real security workflows (not just using AI as an end user) — e.g., building with APIs, agents, or automation to support security use cases. * Experience conducting technical security assessments (e.g. offensive security or validation exercises) across both software and hardware/firmware environments. * Experience in creating solutions for secure code with engineers using languages such as GoLang. * Experience developing AI and agentic solutions using Github, and developing within AWS cloud. **An ideal candidate also has:** * Experience with AI\-specific attack techniques (prompt injection, jailbreaks, model/agent abuse) for vulnerability management and application security. * Experience building or validating security controls for agentic AI, RAG systems, or LLM\-integrated platforms. * A track record of driving org\-wide security strategy or presenting technical findings to senior/executive stakeholders. * Relevant industry certifications (e.g., OSCP, GIAC, CISSP) or AWS certifications. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Warehouse Manager
jobs.description: **Machining Logistics** At **Machining Logistics** , a division of **Sandvik Group** , we are proud of our role in creating a superior customer experience. We support the divisions within Machining in meeting their core business needs by ensuring: On\-time delivery in perfect condition, lowest possible environmental impact, compliance with international laws and regulations and cost efficiency through optimized processes. Our expertise in logistics and collaboration with divisions enables us to deliver value beyond delivery, supporting the 2030 Strategy pillars of enabling growth, lead logistics innovation, accelerate digital, deliver value and efficiency and empower high\-performing teams. Our distribution network includes Distribution Centers in Hebron Kentucky (US), Den Hoorn (NLD), Jundiaí (BRA), Singapore (SGP) and Shanghai (CHN). The headquarters of Machining Logistics is located in Luzern (CHE). Warehouse Operations Manager – Americas Distribution Center Hebron, Kentucky **Your Mission** As Warehouse Operations Manager, you will have overall responsibility for the day\-to\-day execution and performance of warehouse operations at the Americas Distribution Center (ADC). You will be accountable for safety, quality, customer service, productivity, cost, staffing, employee development, and operational performance against defined KPIs. This role requires more than managing daily execution. The Warehouse Operations Manager is expected to understand the end\-to\-end operation, proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities, use data to drive decisions, develop solutions to complex operational problems, and lead the organization through continuous change and improvement. You will translate the Logistics strategy into clear tactical plans, operational priorities, measurable objectives, and sustainable processes. You will establish clear accountability throughout the organization and ensure that operational plans are executed and followed through to completion. You will develop and coach a high\-performing Operations Team capable of providing and maintaining a competitive advantage for our Sales Units while creating an environment of accountability, engagement, collaboration, and continuous development. You will report to the ADC Site Manager and serve as a key member of the ADC Management Team. **Key Responsibilities** **Operational Leadership \& Ownership** * Take full ownership of daily warehouse execution and overall operational performance. * Maintain a strong understanding of the end\-to\-end warehouse flow, including inbound, replenishment, storage, picking, packing, transfers, shipping, and supporting processes. * Maintain an active leadership presence within the operation to understand actual conditions, constraints, risks, and employee needs. * Anticipate operational risks and develop mitigation plans before they negatively impact customers or performance. * Develop short\- and medium\-term operational plans based on expected volume, available capacity, staffing, backlog, and customer requirements. * Ensure clear ownership and accountability for operational actions and commitments. * Establish priorities and allocate resources based on business requirements and data. * Ensure issues are followed through to sustainable resolution rather than relying on temporary countermeasures. Escalate significant business risks appropriately while maintaining ownership of developing potential solutions and recommendations. * **Data Analytics \& Decision Making** The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with operational data rather than relying exclusively on others to prepare or interpret information. Responsibilities include: * Extract, organize, analyze, and interpret operational data from warehouse systems and available reporting tools. * Transform raw operational data into meaningful information that supports business decisions. * Identify trends, abnormalities, constraints, productivity losses, and improvement opportunities through data analysis. * Develop and maintain operational KPIs, dashboards, scorecards, and performance reporting. * Analyze productivity, labor utilization, overtime, capacity, backlog, quality, service performance, and operational costs. * Perform root\-cause analysis using both operational observations and quantitative data. * Validate whether operational changes and improvement projects deliver the expected results. * Develop data\-supported recommendations and clearly communicate findings to senior leadership. * Use data to challenge assumptions and distinguish symptoms from underlying operational problems. * Support business cases through baseline development, benefit validation, ROI analysis, and post\-implementation measurement. **Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience extracting and analyzing data from WMS, ERP, BI, or similar operational systems is required. Experience with Power BI or comparable visualization/analytics platforms is st  across functions when operational priorities or responsibilities overlap. * **Safety, Quality \& Customer Performance** * Maintain a strong safety culture and lead by example. * Ensure compliance with company safety policies and regulatory requirements. * Own operational quality performance and corrective actions. * Ensure root causes of quality failures are identified and sustainable countermeasures implemented. * Maintain strong focus on OTIF/customer service requirements. Balance productivity objectives with safety, quality, employee engagement, and customer requirements. * **Your Profile** We are looking for a proactive, analytical, results\-oriented Operations Manager who combines strong warehouse leadership experience with the ability to use data, solve complex problems, develop people, and lead change. The successful candidate should demonstrate: * Strong end\-to\-end warehouse and distribution operations experience. * Minimum of **5 years of progressively responsible logistics, distribution, supply chain, or warehouse operations experience** , with demonstrated people\-leadership responsibility. * Proven experience leading Supervisors and/or other frontline leaders. * Demonstrated ability to independently manage a complex warehouse or distribution operation. * Strong analytical capability and demonstrated experience using operational data to make decisions. * Ability to independently extract, manipulate, analyze, and interpret operational data. * Advanced Microsoft Excel capability. * Experience with WMS and ERP systems. * Power BI or comparable business\-intelligence experience strongly preferred. * Demonstrated structured problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis capability. * Proven project leadership experience with successful implementation results. * Experience developing business cases and measuring project benefits preferred. * Experience with warehouse automation, technology implementation, or process transformation strongly preferred. * Strong financial and business acumen, including understanding labor costs, productivity, budgets, ROI, and operational cost drivers. * Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset and willingness to challenge established processes. * Strong change\-management capability. * Proven ability to develop leaders and build high\-performing teams. * Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Ability to operate independently while knowing when appropriate escalation is required. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus and follow\-through. * Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant leadership experience. Excellent English communication skills due to the international nature of the organization. * **What Success Looks Like** The successful Warehouse Operations Manager will not simply manage today's workload. jobs.title: Founding Engineer (DreamLever) - NY
jobs.description: **DreamLever / MilesAI Inc. New York City preferred (Hybrid)** ### **Learn more** Visit our website at https://www.dreamlever.ai/ ### **About DreamLever** DreamLever is the AI a company shares. It learns the business through meeting conversations, connects what's happening across people, teams, and goals, and uses AI agents to move work forward. Founded by Brandon Katz, a former Chief of Staff who helped scale a company from 35 to more than 250 people, DreamLever turns firsthand experience building and running a company's management system into software. The product is live with paying customers, including a company with roughly 145 weekly active users across departments.Our external engineering partner, Scope Labs, helped build the product and continues to contribute, providing engineering support and knowledge of the existing system as we build our in\-house team. ### **The Role** As DreamLever's first in\-house engineer, you'll lead technical execution on a live, customer\-facing product. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you'll write code every day, make engineering decisions, and turn product priorities into polished software. You're energized by building and take pride in exceptional output. You'll work closely with the founder to understand the vision, translate detailed direction and prototypes into code, and move quickly from feedback to shipped improvements. Strong product judgment and UI/UX instincts help you resolve details, find efficient solutions, and deliver the intended customer experience. This is a close working relationship with the company's founder. Expect intensive working sessions—reviewing prototypes, debating product decisions, then moving straight into building. The founder leads the product and prototyping in detail; you decide how it gets built. You will own technical execution, drawing on the support of Scope Labs, our external engineering partner, whose team includes product managers, front\-end engineers, and full\-stack developers with deep knowledge of the existing system. You'll coordinate development with the founder, decide what to build autonomously and what to delegate to Scope Labs, and oversee execution to ensure we meet our product goals. ### **What You'll Do** * **Ship high\-impact product improvements quickly.** Build across the full stack, using coding agents effectively to accelerate development and ship well\-tested code daily. * **Turn product intent into working software.** Take founder direction, design prototypes, and detailed feedback through implementation and polish. Resolve gaps and edge cases, and verify that the finished experience achieves the intended customer outcome. * **Learn the existing system deeply and quickly.** Understand the architecture, integrations, data flows, and technical risks well enough to make sound decisions and confidently build upon a live codebase. * **Improve Miles's AI quality.** Develop how Miles, the DreamLever system's AI Chief of Staff agent, uses company context, evaluates information, and takes action. Evaluate its outputs, investigate failures, and iterate on usefulness and reliability. * **Drive coordinated, dependable delivery.** Break priorities into clear work, make realistic commitments, and communicate risks early. Direct and review work delegated to Scope Labs, our external development partner, and hold the line on quality and dates across the full development team. * **Contribute practical product ideas.** Bring creative solutions, strong UI/UX judgment, and ideas from software and productivity tools you know well. Use these insights to improve the customer experience. * **Keep the engineering foundation clear and reliable.** Maintain organized code, consistent naming, and useful documentation. Improve testing, observability, and deployment where they make development faster and safer. ### **Who You Are** **An exceptionally productive builder.** You love writing software and have a track record of shipping substantial production work quickly. You use coding agents fluently, manage multiple streams of work effectively, and take responsibility for the quality of the result. **Quick to understand, quick to execute.** You get oriented in unfamiliar codebases, grasp product intent, and turn direction into working software without extensive task\-by\-task instruction. You ask focused questions, get the context you need, and act decisively. **Focused on outcomes.** You understand what a change is supposed to accomplish for the customer, and follow through until the intended outcome is achieved. You are relentless about what matters, preferring to hit triples rather than polishing singles. When everything appears urgent, you can identify what actually is, and you don't sink time into details that won't move the product. You size up a problem and know how to attack it: what you own directly, what to delegate, and where your time is best spent. **Technically strong across the stack.** You can reason through backend systems, integrations, data models, asynchronous workflows, and user\-facing experiences. You investigate problems methodically, trace failures to their underlying causes, and make pragmatic decisions about speed, reliability, and maintainability. **Experienced with AI in production.** You've built LLM\-enabled features and understand how context, evaluation, and system design affect their quality. You're curious about failures and systematic about improving results. **Thoughtful about the user experience.** You care about making software simple, useful, and polished. You're interested in productivity tools and how people coordinate work, and bring practical ideas that strengthen the founder's vision. **Organized and dependable.** You keep your work understandable, communicate clearly, and make commitments you can keep. When delivery is at risk, you raise it early and help find a path forward. **Collaborative, direct, and receptive to feedback.** You enjoy working closely with an engaged founder. You contribute your perspective, take detailed feedback productively, and care more about a great result than whose idea gets implemented. **Energized by an early\-stage company's pace.** You want meaningful ownership and have the stamina to sustain a high level of output. You understand business goals and are committed to getting us to our next fundraising round, recognizing the importance of deadlines and maintaining pace to get there. ### **Qualifications** * Approximately 3–7 years of experience building and shipping production software, with meaningful ownership of features or systems from implementation through release. Bonus if you've started something of your own or been one of the first engineers at a small company. We're looking for evidence you've owned an outcome end to end rather than worked inside someone else's process. * Strong full\-stack engineering skills, including experience with APIs, integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency. * Demonstrated ability to learn, extend, and improve an existing production codebase. * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-enabled features and using AI coding agents to accelerate development. Experience building agentic workflows and long\-running tasks is a plus. * Strong computer\-science fundamentals, whether developed through formal study or practical experience. * Experience working directly with founders, product leaders, or other non\-engineering stakeholders to turn product priorities into shipped software. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to a wide array of technical and non\-technical collaborators, ensuring team alignment across the product and engineering function. * US\-based. New York City area strongly preferred; remote candidates will still be considered. * Experience and proficiency working with our current stack: TypeScript (Next.js \+ React), Postgres (Supabase). We care more about demonstrated ability, judgment, passion, and ownership than exact years of experience or résumé shape. If this sounds like your kind of work, we'd love to hear from you. ### **Compensation** Base salary: $170,000 to $200,000, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. This is a founding role with meaningful equity vesting over four years. ### **Americans with Disabilities Statement** Must be able to perform all essential functions of this position with reasonable accommodation. ### **EEO Statement** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative, at all job levels, of the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veterans' status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior IT Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Context** Simpro Group is a pioneer of AI\-powered field service software serving over 250,000 users worldwide. Headquartered in Miami, we've been transforming how trades and field service businesses operate since 2013, connecting jobs, people, and performance across plumbing, HVAC, fire \& security, facilities management, electrical contracting, and more. As we grow, we need a Senior IT Security Engineer to sustain and strengthen our certification posture, covering frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, while owning the day\-to\-day security of our internal IT environment.**What You’ll Do** This is a senior individual contributor role based onsite in downtown Miami, reporting to the IT Director. You'll own IT security and compliance end to end, with real autonomy in day\-to\-day execution while strategy is shaped jointly with IT leadership. On the product engineering side, this role is a technical sounding board, advisory rather than an owner of engineering's process. Protecting customer data, meeting our compliance obligations, and safeguarding core systems are never up for negotiation. Beyond that, this role calls for sound judgment on where security effort delivers the most protection without slowing the business down. **What You'll Own** **Security \& Compliance:** Sustain and strengthen our certification posture across frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, lead new certification initiatives as needed, select and implement a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform, and manage prospect and customer security questionnaires **Risk Management:** Build and maintain the risk register across physical, logical, and systems\- level exposure, and prioritize remediation **Identity \& Access Management (IAM):** Audit and remediate shared credential and generic account exposure, improve identity architecture including SSO consolidation and network authentication **Security Operations \& Endpoint Protection:** Select and stand up our EDR/MDR capability, maintain group policy and endpoint standards, secure remote connectivity, own data protection practices, and address physical security risks tied to IT\-managed systems like door access technology **Engineering Security Advisory:** Serve as a sounding board to product engineering on secure configuration, secrets handling, and vulnerability management, in an advisory capacity **Vendor \& Third\-Party Risk:** Assess new and existing SaaS vendors, review security posture and trust documentation on a recurring basis **Incident Response:** Build playbooks, run tabletop exercises, and lead response when incidents occur **What You’ll Bring** * Hands\-on technical depth in identity and access architecture, not just policy writing * Experience selecting and standing up EDR/MDR, and maintaining endpoint and group policy standards * Experience across both logical security (IAM, network segmentation, cloud config) and physical security practices * Comfortable advising engineering teams you don't manage, credible enough that they value your input even without formal authority * Strong communicator who can explain risk and tradeoffs to non\-security stakeholders * Solid working understanding of how SOC 2 and ISO 27001 programs run, close enough to the process to have done real work in it, not just relaying auditor requests. * Owning a certification cycle start to finish is a plus, not a requirement, since you'll work alongside outside compliance consultants who guide the harder parts of the process **Experience \& Education** * 6\+ years in information security or a closely related IT discipline * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or an equivalent combination of professional experience and industry certifications **Nice to Have** * CISSP, CISA, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor certification * Experience with GRC tooling such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe * Background in vendor risk management or third\-party due diligence **Our Technology Landscape** What matters here is how you reason about risk, not which specific tool you've used before. You'll work across identity and access systems, cloud infrastructure, collaboration and AI tooling, and vulnerability management platforms, spanning both our internal IT environment and our product engineering pipeline. **Our Core Values** **We Are One Team** **We Are Customer Centric** **We Are Growth Minded** **We Are Accountable** **We Celebrate Success** Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange \& ClockShark are equal opportunity employers with a best\-of\-class onboarding program and supportive team environments. jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Support Engineer- Night Shift
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **This position is based at the Slate manufacturing facility in Warsaw, IN. Nightshift hours are 7:00pm\-3:30am. EDT** **About Slate** =============== At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **Who we are looking for** ========================== We are looking for a Manufacturing Systems Support Engineer to be the first line of defense when something goes wrong with Slate’s manufacturing technology stack. This is an entry\-level role for someone who is technically grounded, methodically under pressure, and comfortable working on the factory floor alongside operators and supervisors as well as with software engineers and IT. You will diagnose and resolve issues across MES, WMS, CMMS, and their integrations — reading logs, querying data, following a hypothesis, and escalating with precision when you reach the limits of your access. If you are energized by troubleshooting real problems in a fast\-moving environment and want to build deep expertise in how manufacturing software systems work, this is where that career starts. **What you get to do** ====================== * Serve as the first point of contact for manufacturing system issues — triage incoming requests from operators, supervisors, and quality engineers across MES, WMS, and CMMS. * Diagnose software issues by reading application logs, querying databases, and tracing data flows to isolate whether a problem is a user error, a configuration issue, a data integrity problem, or a software defect. * Follow established troubleshooting runbooks to resolve known issue patterns; document any gaps or improvements you discover so the knowledge base stays accurate and genuinely useful. * Escalate to the software engineering team when an issue requires a code fix — write precise escalation tickets that include what you observed, what you ruled out, and what data supports your conclusion. * Monitor system health dashboards and act on anomalies before they become production\-stopping events; know what normal looks like so you can recognize when something isn’t. * Analyze incident data to identify recurring patterns and high\-frequency issue types — surface these trends to the engineering team with supporting data to drive permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds. * Manage user administration tasks including account setup, access provisioning, and permission changes across manufacturing system platforms. * Support software release activities — execute test scripts, validate deployments against expected behavior, and flag regressions before they reach the production floor. Walk the floor when the problem requires it — some issues only make sense when you see them in context at the station where they are happening. * **What you bring to the team** ============================== **Technical skills** * 0–3 years of experience in IT support, helpdesk, technical operations, or a related role; exposure to manufacturing or industrial systems is a bonus but not expected. * Able to read and interpret application logs to distinguish a user error from a misconfiguration from a software defect — the error message is the starting point, not the answer. * Basic SQL: able to write straightforward queries to look up records, verify data integrity, cross\-reference tables, and support incident investigation without needing a developer to pull the data for you. * Working understanding of how web\-based software systems operate — browsers, REST APIs, databases, and how requests flow between them — sufficient to trace where in a stack something went wrong. * Experience using an ITSM ticketing system such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar to manage and document support work. * Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments at an operator and configuration level. * Familiarity with monitoring or observability dashboards such as Grafana, Zabbix or Datadog is a plus. Basic scripting ability in Python, Bash, or similar — not required, but valued and a strong indicator of the curiosity this role rewards. * **How you work** * **Methodical troubleshooter:** you form a hypothesis, test it, confirm or rule it out, and move to the next one. You do not randomly change things hoping the problem goes away. * **Clear communicator under pressure:** when a production line is down, you can tell a supervisor what you know, what you are doing, and what you do not know yet — all in plain language, without adding to the panic. * **Owns the ticket to closure:** you do not close an issue until you have confirmed it is resolved, not just until the user stopped responding. Verified resolution is the bar. * **Curious about root causes:** “It’s working now” is not an acceptable end state when you do not know why it failed. You document what you found even when you cannot yet explain it, because that note prevents the next incident. * **Comfortable on the floor:** manufacturing environments are active and sometimes loud. You are willing to walk out to a station and observe a problem firsthand when context would help you diagnose it faster. * **Keeps learning:** manufacturing systems are broad and deep. You do not need to know everything on day one, but you should want to understand something new every week. **Experience and education** * Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent hands\-on experience that demonstrates the same capabilities. * Manufacturing or industrial environment experience is welcomed but not required for a candidate with strong fundamentals and genuine curiosity about how things get built. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at **slate\-talent\_acquisition@slate.auto.**

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking an Electrical Engineer to design electrical hardware for automated material\-handling robots and related platforms. In this role you will contribute to the schematic design, PCB layout, analysis, prototype support, integration, and test of assigned electrical designs — boards, harnesses, and the interfaces that connect them — from design through release. You will carry assigned work through Symbotic’s Product Development Process (PDP). You will apply established design practices, broaden your capability in the discipline, and partner with more senior electrical designers and with mechanical, firmware, test, and manufacturing so those designs can be built and tested. **What we do** The Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team is part of Symbotic’s Hardware Engineering organization and develops the electrical hardware that powers and connects our robotic systems. Our team designs PCB\-based electronics, harnesses, and electrical interfaces that support power distribution, sensing, compute, communications, and control across our automation platforms. We partner closely with mechanical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and other engineering teams to integrate these designs into reliable, manufacturable robotic products and support them from development through production. **What you'll do** * Design electrical solutions of moderate scope for assigned boards, harnesses, and interfaces (power, sensing, compute interfaces, interconnect, and grounding), using established methods and precedent, and asking for guidance when the assignment is new. * Take assigned designs from schematic through prototype and release: schematic capture, PCB layout, bring\-up support, and the documentation needed for review and release. * Follow the PDP on your work — design reviews, requirements, verification, and release discipline — so assigned designs move on the same path as the rest of the program. * Design schematics and PCB layouts in Altium for assigned boards. Execute placement, routing, and DFM, and apply the stackup, SI/PI, and EMC practices already used on the platform, with review from a more senior designer. * Apply DfX (DFM, DFA, DFT, and related) so assigned designs are manufacturable and testable at the contract manufacturer. * Support PLM work for assigned items (BOM updates, ECO inputs, document release) and support contract\-manufacturer builds. * Contribute to requirements and test procedures, and execute the testing needed to confirm function of the assigned design, including support of EMC/EMI debug with a more senior engineer. * Investigate issues in the lab and implement corrective changes on assigned designs, with support on failures that extend beyond the board. * Select components within approved\-part and design practices for robotics, automation, and automotive\-class environments. * Give informal guidance to less experienced colleagues on day\-to\-day design tasks. * Travel occasionally to the lab, a contract manufacturer, or a site to support bring\-up of assigned hardware. **What you'll need** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. * 2\+ years of electrical design experience, or equivalent experience that shows the same capability. * Working knowledge of Altium schematic capture and PCB layout (or equivalent ECAD, with a demonstrated willingness to work in Altium). * Experience with electronics for automation, robotics, automotive, or similar embedded systems. * Contributes to board\-level design and to interfaces with the larger electrical system (power distribution, grounding, sensors, and interconnect), with guidance on system\-level tradeoffs. * Awareness of safety expectations on automation and robotic platforms, and ability to follow product safety requirements with guidance from Functional Safety. * Working knowledge of EMC/EMI fundamentals (grounding, filtering, return paths, and layout practices) and ability to support debug. * Applies DfX so assigned designs can be built and tested. * Able to follow a formal PDP / phase\-gate process, with moderate guidance on new assignments and little instruction on day\-to\-day work. * Familiarity with PLM and with contract\-manufacturer builds, or a clear ability to learn those practices on the job. * Builds productive working relationships and explains technical information clearly to teammates who know the subject. * Works collaboratively with mechanical, firmware, test, operations, and supply chain in a results\-oriented, project\-driven team. **Physical and Environment Requirements** * Wilmington, MA preferred (lab and cross\-functional presence). Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, test facilities, or sites as required. * Lab and occasional warehouse / site work around automated equipment. **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $82,000\.00 \- $113,300\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.description: **Map the Future — Leave Your Mark as a Party Chief at TAIT** **Why TAIT?** **Field Leadership** —Guide survey crews and keep field operations running safely and accurately **Hands\-On Impact** — Support construction staking, boundary, topographic, \& development projects **Grow Your Expertise** —Strengthen your technical, project coordination, and leadership skills **Advance with Purpose** — Collaborate with surveyors and engineers while building your career From lines on a map to lasting impact—survey with purpose at TAIT. **Role at a Glance** The Survey Party Chief will plan and evaluate proposed field survey projects and manage the field survey teams. This position will be a huge support to our survey \& engineering teams. The Party Chief is responsible for checking the accuracy of the survey party’s work, making accurate measurements, and solving survey problems that may arise. This position will be expected to work well remotely with all necessary equipment, as well as be able to provide support in the field as needed. Our survey team supports public, private commercial, and industrial development projects. **What You’ll Do*** Plan and coordinate field design surveys, construction staking, and other survey work. * Perform complex calculations, verify raw data accuracy, provide GIS information, and maintain survey records and project files. * Prepare finished\-grade sheets, topographic maps, Records of Survey, ALTA surveys, corner staking, and related deliverables. * Research and interpret record maps, plans, deeds, easements, and right\-of\-way documents. * Support field crews using AutoCAD Civil 3D 2020; analyze boundaries, process field data, and provide equipment and technical guidance. * Prioritize and delegate team assignments, provide technical feedback, and coordinate with clients and engineers. * Conduct construction\-site inspections while safely navigating varied terrain and weather conditions. **What You’ll Need*** 5\+ years of experience preparing Subdivision Maps, including Tract Maps, Parcel Maps, and Records of Survey. * Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D 2020 and Carlson data\-collection software. * Experience supporting a PLS with boundary analysis and field\-data processing. * Skilled in preparing ALTA and topographic surveys and converting field data into final deliverables, including utility plots. * Experience preparing map\-check sheets, reviewing closures and title documents, and interpreting easements and dedications. * Knowledge of City and County records, including Record Maps, tie notes, Corner Records, and Improvement Plans. * Experience preparing plan\-check submittal packages and coordinating mapping and survey projects with clients and municipal agencies. **Physical Requirements*** Walk and stand for 8\+ hours daily across multiple job sites, including uneven terrain and varying weather conditions. * Lift, carry, and load survey equipment weighing 5–50 pounds. * Drive to multiple job sites each workday. * Communicate effectively with job\-site team members. * Remain alert to traffic, construction equipment, and other environmental hazards. * Complete an annual physical. **Salary and Benefits** Salary range for position: $30/hr. \- $40/hr. **Benefits** TAIT invests in you by providing a comprehensive compensation and benefits program along with the opportunity for professional growth and development. Our benefits package includes valuable and affordable options for health, dental, vision, employer paid life insurance, 401(k) with match, generous paid time off and other supplemental benefits.
